items.title: 記憶體股血流成河 馬斯克一句話救信心：供不應求才剛開始
items.title_en: Memory Stocks Flooded with Blood, Musk’s One Sentence Restores Confidence: Supply Shortage Is Just Beginning
paras: 美國兩大記憶體廠商 SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 與威騰電子 (WDC-US) 雖公布亮眼財報，但業績展望未達市場高期待，引發投資人失望，兩家公司股價週三（5 日）美股盤後雙雙重挫。記憶體股賣壓隨後蔓延至亞洲，南韓「記憶體雙雄」SK 海力士 (000660KS) 與三星電子 (005930KS) 週四分別下跌 10.3% 及 6.3%，日本快閃記憶體大廠鎧俠股價也暴跌逾 10%，市場憂慮 AI 帶動的記憶體行情面臨獲利預期修正壓力。
然而，在 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克看來，投資者完全不應為記憶體的需求感到擔憂，因為在 AI 熱潮中，最大的瓶頸之一正是記憶體。他明確表示，記憶體晶片的需求增長速度遠遠超過了供應增速。
馬斯克對記憶體晶片的需求狀況具備很強的發言權，因為特斯拉和 SpaceX 均是記憶體晶片的重要買家。特斯拉和 SpaceX 的未來發展都高度依賴於人工智能，並且都在大舉斥資採購 AI 晶片、記憶體晶片以及其它用於數據中心的 AI 基礎設施，這意味著馬斯克擁有洞察記憶體需求的絕佳視角。
SpaceX 週三公佈了 IPO 後的首份業績，隨後的電話會議展示了關於火箭、機器人、星艦和衛星的宏大計劃。然而，對於緊盯半導體股票、每日跟隨晶片股行情變動的市場而言，真正抓住人們眼球的是馬斯克關於記憶體晶片的深刻言論。
「目前的限制因素是記憶體，」馬斯克直言，「記憶體產量每年增長約 20%。通常來說，這對任何龐大且成熟的行業而言，這一速度已經非常驚人。但請想一想：需求每年增長 20% 嗎？不，需求每年增長 200% 甚至更多。所以，當需求的增長速度遠超供給時，基礎經濟學原理告訴我們，價格應該上漲，而不是下跌。」
馬斯克的這一觀點，與一些分析師近期提出的理論形成了鮮明對比。
此前，部分分析師認為 SK 海力士等公司的產能擴張，可能會導致記憶體晶片供過於求並壓低價格。整個夏季，市場都在激烈爭論半導體超級週期能否延續，投資者對 AI 資本開支熱潮能持續多久充滿疑慮。
在 7 月遭受重創後，進入 8 月晶片類股行情雖有所回暖，但當前圍繞晶片類股的市場情緒仍然十分脆弱。由於 Sandisk 和威騰電子的業績，未能滿足投資者的超高期待，週四亞洲市場上的記憶體族群才出現了大幅下跌。
儘管 SanDisk 與威騰電子的營收和利潤均超出市場預期，但 Sandisk 的業績指引略微不及市場預期，而威騰電子的指引也未能帶來任何驚喜，相較於希捷科技上週給出的業績指引要遜色得多。
高盛指出，過高的市場預期令兩家公司的股價難以從亮眼業績中獲益，導致業績公佈後兩檔股票雙雙承壓下跌。馬斯克此次的公開表態，或許能為動盪不安的記憶體晶片市場注入一劑強心針。
paras_en: U.S. memory giants SanDisk (SNDKV-US) and Western Digital (WDC-US) posted impressive earnings, but their outlook fell short of lofty market expectations, disappointing investors and sending both stocks sharply lower after Wednesday’s (the 5th) U.S. market close. The sell‑off in memory stocks then spread to Asia, where South Korea’s “memory twins” SK Hynix (000660KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930KS) fell 10.3% and 6.3% respectively on Thursday, and Japanese flash‑memory leader Kioxia saw its shares plunge more than 10%, as the market worries that AI‑driven memory demand is now facing profit‑margin revisions.

However, SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk argues investors should not worry about memory demand at all, because one of the biggest bottlenecks in the AI boom is precisely memory. He stated clearly that the growth rate of demand for memory chips far outpaces the growth rate of supply.

Musk’s view on memory‑chip demand carries weight because both Tesla and SpaceX are major buyers of memory chips. Their future development is heavily dependent on artificial intelligence, and they are pouring money into AI chips, memory chips and other AI‑infrastructure for data centers, giving Musk an excellent perspective on memory demand.

SpaceX released its first post‑IPO earnings on Wednesday, and the subsequent earnings call highlighted ambitious plans for rockets, robots, Starship and satellites. Yet for a market that watches semiconductor stocks and chip‑stock movements daily, the real headline‑grabber was Musk’s pointed comments on memory chips.

“The current constraint is memory,” Musk said bluntly. “Memory production is growing about 20% a year. For any large, mature industry that’s already a remarkable rate. But think about this: does demand grow 20% a year? No – demand is growing 200% or more each year. So when demand outpaces supply that dramatically, basic economics tells us prices should rise, not fall.”
Musk’s viewpoint stands in stark contrast to theories recently put forward by some analysts.

Earlier, several analysts warned that capacity expansions by companies such as SK Hynix could lead to oversupply of memory chips and push prices down. Throughout the summer, the market has fiercely debated whether the semiconductor super‑cycle can continue, and investors remain skeptical about how long the AI‑capex frenzy will last.

After a heavy hit in July, the chip sector showed some recovery in August, but sentiment around chip stocks remains fragile. Because SanDisk’s and Western Digital’s results failed to meet investors’ sky‑high expectations, the memory segment in Asian markets slumped sharply on Thursday.

Although both SanDisk and Western Digital posted revenue and profit above market forecasts, SanDisk’s guidance fell slightly short of expectations and Western Digital’s outlook offered no surprises, lagging far behind the guidance Seagate gave last week.

Goldman Sachs noted that overly lofty market expectations made it hard for the two companies’ shares to benefit from their strong results, causing both stocks to slide after the announcements. Musk’s public remarks may provide a much‑needed boost to the turbulent memory‑chip market.

items.title: SK海力士在Nextrade盤前交易驚現30%「閃崩」其交易機制引發市場質疑
items.title_en: SK Hynix Experiences 30% Flash Crash in Pre‑Market Trading on Nextrade, Raising Market Concerns
paras: 南韓半導體巨頭 SK 海力士周四 (6 日) 在南韓另類交易系統 (ATS)Nextrade 的盤前交易中，再次遭遇短暫的「閃崩」事件，這已是一周內發生的第二次異常波動，引發市場對於新型交易所交易穩定性的高度關注。
根據 Nextrade 交易數據，當地時間周四上午 8 點盤前交易開市時，SK 海力士共有 11 股以每股 1,168,000 韓元的價格成交，瞬間觸及 30% 的單日跌停限制。儘管跌勢驚人，但隨後在為時 50 分鐘的交易時段中，股價迅速收復失地，最終盤前僅小跌約 2%。
相較之下，受華爾街科技股走弱影響，SK 海力士在南韓交易所 (KRX) 周四早盤表現雖然疲軟，跌幅一度達 9.8%，但並未出現如 Nextrade 般的極端劇烈震盪。
這類「閃崩」現象不僅侷限於傳統股市，其產生的異常價格也會波及追蹤該股的海外衍生性商品。上周二發生的類似事件，曾導致掛鉤 SK 海力士的加密貨幣衍生品合約，在兩分鐘內觸發了近 6,000 萬美元的多單平倉。
不過，周四這次事件對加密市場的衝擊較小，在 Hyperliquid 區塊鏈平台上的強制清算金額僅約 23 萬美元，分析師認為這是因為先前的波動，已提前清理了市場上的大部分槓桿。
Nextrade 自去年推出以來，憑藉更長的交易時間與更低廉的手續費迅速擴大市場份額。然而，由於這一交易所與主流平台不同，在盤前時段採用連續競價 ，而非集合競價，且僅依賴單一定價來源，被認為削弱了「價格發現」的功能，容易在流動性不足時產生異常成交價。
針對市場質疑，Nextrade 表示另類交易所更強調「交易執行」。為了防止此類事件重演，Nextrade 計畫於 9 月 14 日引進「靜態波動中斷機制」(Static Volatility Interruption)。屆時若報價與前一收盤價偏差超過 10%，將啟動兩分鐘的拍賣程序，以選出能執行最多交易的合理價格。
專家警告，在機制完善前，投資者應留意此類市場結構性風險，避免因異常成交價導致不必要的投資損失。
paras_en: South Korean semiconductor giant SK Hynix on Thursday (the 6th) suffered another brief “flash crash” during pre‑market trading on the country’s alternative trading system (ATS) Nextrade, marking the second abnormal swing within a week and sparking heightened scrutiny of the new venue’s trading stability.

According to Nextrade data, when pre‑market trading opened at 8 a.m. local time on Thursday, SK Hynix recorded 11 shares trading at 1,168,000 won per share, instantly hitting the 30% daily limit‑down. Although the plunge was dramatic, the price recovered quickly during the 50‑minute session, ending the pre‑market session down only about 2%.

In contrast, affected by weaker Wall Street tech stocks, SK Hynix’s early session on the Korea Exchange (KRX) was sluggish, slipping as much as 9.8% but without the extreme volatility seen on Nextrade.

Such flash‑crash episodes are not confined to traditional equity markets; the anomalous pricing can spill over to overseas derivative products that track the stock. A similar incident last Tuesday triggered nearly $60 million of long‑position liquidations in crypto‑linked SK Hynix derivative contracts within two minutes.

However, Thursday’s event had a much smaller impact on the crypto market, with forced liquidations on the Hyperliquid blockchain platform amounting to only about $230,000, which analysts attribute to prior volatility that had already cleared most leveraged exposure.

Since its launch last year, Nextrade has rapidly gained market share thanks to longer trading hours and lower fees. Yet, because the venue differs from mainstream platforms—using continuous auction in the pre‑market instead of a call auction and relying on a single pricing source—it is said to weaken price‑discovery and can produce abnormal trade prices when liquidity is thin.

Addressing market concerns, Nextrade said alternative exchanges place greater emphasis on “trade execution.” To prevent a repeat, Nextrade plans to introduce a “Static Volatility Interruption” mechanism on September 14; if quotes deviate more than 10% from the previous close, a two‑minute auction will be triggered to select a reasonable price that can accommodate the most trades.
Experts warn that until the mechanism is refined, investors should be mindful of this structural market risk and avoid unnecessary losses caused by abnormal trade prices.

items.title: 台股7月急跌3000點 0050淨申購逾1700億元創歷史新高
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Plunges 3,000 Points in July, 0050 Sees Record Net Buying of Over NT$17.7 Trillion
paras: 台股 7 月急跌逾 3000 點，長期資金視為絕佳進場機會，台股 ETF 單月淨申購金額突破 5500 億元，指標 ETF 元大台灣 50(0050-TW) 淨申購逾 1700 億元，寫下歷史新高，今年以來已三度單月破千億，反映投資人仍視其為逢低加碼主旋律。
7 月台股遭逢劇烈修正，市場資金轉流向「市值型布局、高股息配置」雙軌並進的成熟操作。一方面看好台股中長期發展，持續加碼市值雙雄 0050、00631L，淨申購金額分別達 1766.2 億元、477.2 億元，創下單月新高及次高的紀錄，穩居熱門 ETF 冠亞軍。
另一方面，波段恐慌也激發穩健型資金避險防禦心理，由 0056 逆勢吸引逾 376.7 億元資金流入，強勢奪下 7 月高股息 ETF 第一，扛起穩定投資信心的基石。
0050 今年已三度展現吸金千億的強勁動能，3 月市場大幅震盪，投資人視跌勢為布局契機，單月淨申購即達 1516 億元；6 月高檔整理之際，再度吸金 1685 億元。7 月面對台股新一波修正，資金再展現越跌越買的強悍韌性，顯見「成熟投資人」無畏外資調節持股，看好市場長期成長與反彈契機，把握低檔分批布局。
00631L 追求台灣 50 指數正向 2 倍績效，反彈力道更是強勁，統計史上五大單日跌幅包括 2025/4 對等關稅、2024/8 日圓升值、2018/10 美中貿易戰，以及 2020/3 全球疫情，後六個月漲幅達 24.3% 至 147.3%、後一年漲幅達 40.5% 至 314.9%，而 7/17 單日下跌 13.5% 即為第五大，後續反彈動能備受期待。
法人表示，「第四法人」持續透過 0050、00631L 等產品，資金逆勢承接大型權值股，不僅成為支撐台股的重要買盤來源，也有望成為推動下一波行情的關鍵力量。

paras_en: The Taiwan stock market plummeted over 3,000 points in July, with long-term funds viewing it as an excellent entry point. The Taiwan stock ETF saw a record net buying amount of NT$55 billion in a single month, with the index ETF, Taiex 50 (0050-TW), seeing net buying of over NT$17.7 trillion, setting a new historical high. This is the third time this year that the index ETF has seen net buying of over NT$1 trillion in a single month, reflecting investors' continued optimism about the market.

In July, the Taiwan stock market underwent a sharp correction, with funds flowing into "value-type layout, high dividend allocation" mature operations. On one hand, investors are optimistic about the long-term development of the Taiwan stock market and continue to add to their holdings of value-type stocks, including 0050 and 00631L, with net buying amounts of NT$176.6 billion and NT$47.7 billion, respectively, setting new monthly highs and second-highest records, solidifying their positions as the top two most popular ETFs.

On the other hand, the fear of short-term fluctuations has also triggered risk-averse funds to adopt a defensive strategy, with 0056 attracting over NT$37.7 billion in net buying, taking the top spot as the highest-dividend ETF in July and serving as a cornerstone for stable investment confidence.

0050 has already demonstrated its strong ability to attract net buying of over NT$1 trillion three times this year. In March, the market experienced a sharp correction, and investors saw the decline as an opportunity to add to their holdings, with net buying of NT$151.6 billion in a single month. In June, when the market was in a high-profile correction, the index ETF again attracted net buying of NT$16.85 trillion. In July, when the market underwent a new correction, funds once again demonstrated their strong ability to buy more when the market declines, showing that "mature investors" are not afraid of foreign capital adjustments and are optimistic about the market's long-term growth and rebound opportunities.

00631L is designed to track the Taiwan 50 index with a 2x return, and its rebound strength is also strong. According to historical data, the five largest single-day declines include the 2025/4 equal tax rate, the 2024/8 yen appreciation, the 2018/10 US-China trade war, and the 2020/3 global pandemic. In the six months following these events, the index ETF saw gains of 24.3% to 147.3%, and in the following year, gains of 40.5% to 314.9%. The 7/17 single-day decline of 13.5% was the fifth-largest, and the subsequent rebound potential is highly anticipated.

A professional investor noted that the "fourth institutional investor" has continued to use products such as 0050 and 00631L to absorb large-cap stocks, not only becoming an important source of buying demand for the Taiwan stock market but also potentially becoming a key driving force for the next round of market trends.

items.title: Situational Awareness基金斷臂求生後 已花4億美元重返投資市場
items.title_en: Situational Awareness Fund Re-enters Investment Market After Near Collapse
paras: 前 OpenAI 研究員、現年 25 歲的華爾街新晉投資者 Leopold Aschenbrenner，其執掌的避險基金 Situational Awareness 在經歷了瀕臨崩潰僅僅幾天之後，已經重返投資市場，對一家非上市公司押注 4 億美元。

在 7 月初，Situational Awareness 的資產規模曾高達 450 億美元，但隨著其持有的上市科技股價值迅速縮水，引發了華爾街貸款機構大規模追繳保證金。為了應對資金壓力，Aschenbrenner 一度考慮出售其引以為傲的私募股權，如 Anthropic、Fluidstack 與 MatX 等公司的股份。最終，他與 Ken Griffin 旗下的 Citadel 達成協議，出售了大部分的上市股票組合，以償還貸款並保住私募股權持倉。
這也讓他付出了極大的代價，截至上周四，這支基金的資產規模已暴跌至約 100 億美元，早先槓桿押注賺取的巨額收益，在保證金追繳令的追殺下已付之一炬。
儘管基金元氣大傷，但 Aschenbrenner 隨即展現了重返市場的決心。據知情人士透露，基金已於本周二向一家非上市公司投資 4 億美元，這是繼上個月投入 1 億美元後的追加投資。雖然目前尚不清楚這筆資金具體流向投資組合中的哪家公司，但此舉被視為他試圖透過長期價值投資來重建基金的初步信號。
Situational Awareness 的投資者結構特殊，大多為舊金山灣區的富裕人士與家族辦公室，包括 D1 Capital 創辦人 Dan Sundheim 等知名大咖。儘管經歷劇震，目前尚未出現大規模撤資跡象。
Aschenbrenner 在致投資者的信中承諾，他幾乎所有的個人資產都投入了這支基金，並將從此次經驗中吸取教訓，成為更強大的投資人。
值得一提的是，在基金動盪最劇烈的那個周六，Aschenbrenner 於加州卡梅爾谷完成婚禮，其妻子現任 Anthropic 執行長的幕僚長。這場被譽為「AI 皇室婚禮」的慶典與基金的生存保衛戰同時上演，戲劇性十足。目前他已取消蜜月，親自與每位擔憂的投資者進行電話溝通以安撫情緒。
paras_en: Leopold Aschenbrenner, a 25-year-old former OpenAI researcher and new investor on Wall Street, has led his hedge fund Situational Awareness back into the investment market after a near-collapse, betting $4 billion on a private company.

In early July, Situational Awareness had assets of $45 billion, but the value of its publicly traded tech stocks plummeted, triggering a massive margin call from Wall Street lenders. To address the funding pressure, Aschenbrenner considered selling his prized private equity stakes, including those in Anthropic, Fluidstack, and MatX. Ultimately, he reached an agreement with Ken Griffin's Citadel to sell most of his public stock portfolio to repay loans and preserve his private equity holdings.
This came at a great cost, as the fund's assets had plummeted to around $10 billion by last Thursday, with the huge profits from its earlier leveraged bets wiped out by the margin calls.

Despite the fund's severe losses, Aschenbrenner quickly demonstrated his determination to re-enter the market. According to insiders, the fund invested $4 billion in a private company on Tuesday, following an additional $1 billion investment last month. Although it is unclear which company received the funding, this move is seen as a sign of his attempt to rebuild the fund through long-term value investing.

Situational Awareness has a unique investor structure, primarily consisting of wealthy individuals and family offices from the San Francisco Bay Area, including D1 Capital founder Dan Sundheim. Despite the turmoil, there are no signs of massive withdrawals yet.
In a letter to investors, Aschenbrenner pledged that nearly all of his personal assets are invested in the fund and that he will learn from this experience to become a stronger investor.

Notably, during the most turbulent week for the fund, Aschenbrenner got married in California's Carmel Valley, with his wife serving as the chief of staff to the CEO of Anthropic. This 'AI royal wedding' took place simultaneously with the fund's survival battle, making for a dramatic scene. Aschenbrenner has now canceled his honeymoon and is personally calling concerned investors to reassure them.

items.title: 史上第3檔萬金股！股后川湖5天漲逾40% 明日法說會釋展望
items.title_en: The 3rd “Ten‑Thousand‑Dollar Stock” in History! Stock queen Chuanhu up over 40% in five days; tomorrow’s earnings briefing to outline outlook
paras: 伺服器導軌廠川湖 (2059-TW) 於將於今 (6) 日下午公布財報，預定於明 (7) 日舉行法說會，隨著 AI 伺服器出貨強勁業績走旺，今日盤中股價衝破 10000 元關卡，高點觸及 10035 元刷新歷史新高，終場強勢大漲 630 元，收在 10100 元，漲幅高達 6.65%，正式成為台股史上第三檔萬金股。
台股史上首檔萬金股為現任股王信驊 (5274-TW)，第二檔則由半導體測試介面廠穎崴 (6515-TW) 奪下，川湖本次在法說會前夕成功跨越萬元大關並登頂股後，成為第三家加入萬金俱樂部的指標大廠。
美系外資先前出具報告指出，川湖下半年訂單能見度極為強勁，除了 AI 伺服器持續成長外，中央處理器機架、交換器機架及電源機架等設備對伺服器滑軌的採用率持續升級，加上美國廠預計於今年 9 至 10 月投產、高雄新廠規劃於 2027 年下半年加入營運，將推動產品毛利率與營益率持續改善。
paras_en: Server rail manufacturer Chuanhu (2059‑TW) will release its financial report this afternoon (the 6th) and is scheduled to hold an earnings conference tomorrow (the 7th). With strong AI server shipments driving robust performance, the stock price broke the NT$10,000 barrier during intraday trading, hitting a high of NT$10,035 to set a historic new high. It closed strongly up NT$630 at NT$10,100, a gain of 6.65%, officially becoming the third ever ten‑thousand‑dollar stock in Taiwan’s market.

The first ever ten‑thousand‑dollar stock in Taiwan was the current market leader Xin Hua (5274‑TW), the second was semiconductor test‑interface company Ying Wei (6515‑TW). Chuanhu, on the eve of its earnings briefing, successfully crossed the ten‑thousand‑dollar mark and topped the stock‑queen rank, becoming the third flagship company to join the ten‑thousand‑dollar club.

A U.S.–based foreign‑investor report previously noted that Chuanhu’s order visibility for the second half of the year is extremely strong. In addition to continued growth of AI servers, the adoption rate of server slides in CPU racks, switch racks and power racks is continuously upgrading. Moreover, a U.S. plant is expected to start production between September and October this year, and a new plant in Kaohsiung is planned to commence operations in the second half of 2027, which will drive ongoing improvement in product gross margin and operating margin.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉權值股疲軟、千金股唱高調 跌214點守住季線 中止日K連4紅
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market: Value Stocks Weaken, Penny Stocks Surge, Index Holds Above Seasonal Line
paras: 台股今 (6) 日在受電子、金融權值股疲弱，開低震盪走低，早盤下跌逾 600 點，最低來到 4 萬 4 千點附近，以鋼鐵、散熱、高價股及 7 月營收亮眼的中小型股表現較佳，盤中隨著權值股跌勢回穩，終場下跌 214.9 點或 0.48％，收 44,396.7 點，守住季線，但中止日 K 連 4 紅，成交量較前日縮減至 9,403.91 億元。
櫃買 (OTC) 市場部分，今日表現優於集中市場，上漲 1.99％，日 K 連收 5 紅。
在權值股部分，台積電 (2330-TW) 今日開低走低，最後一盤遭砍 4,217 張，跌 1.66％或 40 元，收 2,365 元；聯發科 (2454-TW) 跌 2％，跌破 4,000 元大關；鴻海 (2317-TW)7 月營收亮眼，漲 2.32％；群創 (3481-TW) 漲 4.6％、台達電 (2308-TW) 漲 1.82％。
金融權值股今日則表現無力，壽險雙雄富邦金 (2882-TW)、國泰金 (2881-TW) 跌於 2-3％，凱基金 (2883-TW)、台新新光金 (2887-TW) 跌 3％以上，元大金 (2885-TW) 跌 2.3％。
鋼鐵股部分，因全球鋼鐵市場進到第 3 季展開修正，近期因浮現四大築底訊號，第 4 季景氣回升的可能性大增，激勵東和鋼鐵 (2006-TW) 亮燈鎖漲停、大成鋼 (2027-TW) 漲逾 4％、新鋼 (2032-TW) 漲逾 8％、新光鋼 (2031-TW) 漲半根漲停板。
散熱族群受惠 AI 伺服器持續升級、高功耗晶片帶動液冷散熱需求快速攀升，今日盤中獲資金點火，包括富世達 (6805-TW)、建準 (2421-TW)、邁科 (6831-TW)、雙鴻 (3324-TW) 齊嗨收漲停，奇鋐 (3017-TW) 漲 7％以上，建策 (3653-TW)、泰碩 (3338 -TW) 大漲 2.5％以上。
高價股部分，除了萬金股王信驊 (5274-TW) 大漲 4.56％，股后川湖 (2059-TW) 也大漲 6.65％，收 10,100 元也晉升萬金股，成為台股第 3 檔股價衝破 1 萬元的個股。今天千金股增至 49 檔，盤中多檔 9 檔亮燈漲停。
分析師表示，今日台股拉回修正，量能也受到萎縮，主要是權值股受到壓抑，在量減價跌下，短線正乖離較大，投資人可以關注 7 月最新營收，半年季財報及近期法說會的消息，今日類股大多為跌深類股展開反彈趨勢，籌碼上可留意外資在期貨空單上的布局。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market declined today, with value stocks weakening and penny stocks surging. The market opened lower and fell by over 600 points, with a low of around 44,400. However, the market rebounded in the afternoon, with value stocks stabilizing, and the index closed down 214.9 points or 0.48%, at 44,396.7. The market held above the seasonal line, but the daily K line ended in red for the fourth consecutive day, with a trading volume of 94.0391 billion NT dollars, down from the previous day.
The over-the-counter (OTC) market performed better than the main market, rising 1.99% and closing in red for the fifth consecutive day.

In the value stock sector, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC, 2330-TW) opened lower and fell by 1.66% or 40 NT dollars, closing at 2,365 NT dollars. MediaTek (2454-TW) fell by 2%, breaking the 4,000 NT dollar barrier. Hon Hai Precision Industry (2317-TW) reported strong July sales, rising 2.32%. Group Technology (3481-TW) rose 4.6%, and Delta Electronics (2308-TW) rose 1.82%.

Financial value stocks were weak today, with Fubon Financial Holding (2882-TW) and CTBC Financial Holding (2881-TW) falling by 2-3%. Cathay Financial Holding (2883-TW) and Shin Kong Financial Holding (2887-TW) fell by over 3%, and E.Sun Financial Holding (2885-TW) fell by 2.3%.

The steel stock sector was boosted by the global steel market's entry into the third quarter, with a correction underway. The recent emergence of four major bottom signals has increased the possibility of a fourth-quarter economic rebound, leading to a surge in steel stocks. Eastern Steel (2006-TW) rose to the limit, while Dalian Steel (2027-TW) rose over 4%, New Steel (2032-TW) rose over 8%, and New Steel (2031-TW) rose half a point to the limit.

The heat dissipation sector benefited from the continuous upgrade of AI servers and the rapid increase in demand for liquid cooling heat dissipation due to high-power chips. The sector received funding during the day, with stocks such as Fuxida (6805-TW), Jianzhun (2421-TW), Maike (6831-TW), and Shuanghong (3324-TW) all closing at the limit. Qifeng (3017-TW) rose by over 7%, while Jianshe (3653-TW) and Taishan (3338-TW) rose by over 2.5%.

The high-priced stock sector saw a surge in stocks such as Shin Yeh (5274-TW), which rose 4.56%, and Shanghui (2059-TW), which rose 6.65% and closed at 10,100 NT dollars, becoming the third-tier stock to break the 10,000 NT dollar barrier. Today, there are 49 stocks with a market value of over 1 billion NT dollars, with 9 stocks rising to the limit during the day.

Analysts believe that the market today is correcting, with a decrease in trading volume. The main reason is that value stocks are being suppressed, leading to a large deviation in the short term. Investors can focus on the latest July sales, semi-annual financial reports, and recent earnings calls. Today, most stocks are in the decline category, with a trend of rebounding. Investors should pay attention to the layout of foreign investors in futures contracts.

items.title: AI狂潮變雙面刃！台韓科技股劇烈震盪 新興市場波動超越新冠疫情
paras: 在人工智慧 (AI) 熱潮下，主導高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 與先進記憶體的南韓、台灣企業大漲，也讓新興市場股市今年成為全球焦點，逐漸擺脫過去追隨美股的角色。
新興市場基金經理人 Carlos von Hardenberg 於 2018 年與新興市場投資老將墨比爾斯 (Mark Mobius) 共同創立 MCP Emerging Markets。他說：「過去投資人只對美國和『科技七巨頭』(Magnificent Seven) 有興趣，因為它們表現實在太好了。但今年情況完全反轉。」
然而，AI 行情也帶來沉重代價。自 6 月底以來，新興市場科技股劇烈震盪，彷彿投資人突然出現「高原反應」。
南韓 KOSPI 指數在三星電子與 SK 海力士帶動下，一度翻倍上漲，但隨後因市場疑慮及監管措施影響，短短六周內回跌約 40%，台積電 (TSM-US) 股價也回落近 14%。
這波修正使南韓市場波動率急升，就連涵蓋 24 個國家、逾 1175 檔股票、市值約 1.8 兆美元的 MSCI 新興市場指數，其波動率也超越新冠疫情高峰。

AI 讓新興市場愈來愈像美股

法國巴黎銀行 (BNP Paribas) 亞太現金股票研究主管 William Bratton 表示，目前許多機構投資人已難以承受南韓市場的劇烈波動。他說：「我們接觸到的機構投資人認為，即使基本面仍相當強勁，目前也不值得冒這麼大的波動風險。」
MSCI 仍將南韓與台灣列為新興市場，主要是因為外資交易兩地貨幣仍存在限制。
但部分市場人士認為，AI 熱潮讓新興市場出現過去夢寐以求的科技股行情，如今卻演變成「小心願望成真」。
目前在 MSCI 新興市場指數中，僅九家公司便占了權重逾 40%，包括台灣、南韓大型科技股，以及中國阿里巴巴 (BABA-US) 與騰訊 (00700-HK) 等企業，集中度甚至高於美股。
MSCI 研究主管 Ashley Lester 說：「過去投資人把新興市場視為分散投資來源，但如今隨著 AI 硬體龍頭崛起，新興市場已不再具有過去那種分散效果。它們如今正處於 AI 熱潮的核心。」

外資撤離亞洲 創十多年最大規模

歐洲最大資產管理公司東方匯理 (Amundi) 基金經理人 Ji Young Park 表示，她在市場震盪前已開始降低部分持股，但修正幅度仍讓基金承受不小壓力。
她透露：「過去一個月，南韓股市觸發熔斷機制約六、七次，可見波動程度之高。」
Ji Young Park 表示，她的投資期限約五年，因此並不偏好如此劇烈波動的市場，「我只希望晚上能睡得著。」
瑞士聯合私人銀行 (UBP) 科技投資組合經理人 Dimitri Kallianiotis 則表示，部分私人銀行客戶確實受到市場震盪影響，但他的建議仍是不要恐慌。
倫敦證券交易所集團 (LSEG) 資料顯示，今年上半年，國際資金撤出亞洲 (不含中國) 股市的速度，至少是 2010 年以來同期最快。摩根大通 (JPM-US) 統計也顯示，南韓及台灣首當其衝，分別流出超過 1000 億美元及 440 億美元資金。
由於市場規定基金不得持有單一個股過高比重，投資人也趁三星電子與 SK 海力士過去一年分別大漲約 500% 及 1100% 後，先行獲利了結。
UBP 的 Kallianiotis 說：「投資人應該接受波動，同時避免追逐市場最熱門的股票。如果在最劇烈修正時完全沒有持股，也很可能錯過之後的反彈。」

items.title: 世紀風電上半年EPS 9.3元創同期高 訂單能見度看至2029年
items.title_en: Century Wind Power Reports Record-High EPS of NT$9.3 in First Half of 2023
paras: 世紀風電 (2072-TW) 公告最新財報，累計今年上半年稅後純益 16.91 億元，年增超過 9 成，每股純益 9.3 元，創歷史同期新高。世紀風電指出，下半年工程進度如其推進，加上水下基礎統包工程 (EPC) 比重提升，看好今年營收再創高，且訂單能見度已看至 2029 年。
世紀風電第二季營收 48.98 億元，季增 24.1%，年增 86.6%；毛利率 20.6%，季減 10.3 個百分點，年減 4.5 個百分點；營益率 18.8%，季減 9.5 個百分點，年減 1.9 個百分點；稅後純益 7.88 億，季減 12.7%，年增 70.8%，每股純益 4.11 元，創歷史同期新高。
世紀風電表示，受惠水下基礎 EPC 比重提升，且工程進度如其認列，推升第二季營收表現。毛利率方面，則因 EPC 專案涵蓋範疇較廣，加上合約總值較高，進一步稀釋第二季毛利水準。
世紀風電累計今年上半年營收 88.46 億元，年增 63.3%；毛利率 25.2%，年增 1.8 個百分點；營益率 23.1%，年增 3.3 個百分點；稅後純益 16.92 億元，年增 91%，每股純益 9.3 元，寫歷史同期新高。
世紀風電董事會今年 6 月通過以發行新股方式，取得世紀樺欣 (7752-TW)100% 股權，並擬更名為「世紀能源設備」，將於 8 月 12 日股東臨時會決議。整併後，計畫透過上下游整合，世紀風電可完整發揮台北港與台中港的雙基地優勢，未來在關鍵零組件掌握、原物料共同採購、品質控管與工程管理可望發揮綜效。
展望後市，世紀風電表示將鎖定三大發展方向，包括深耕台灣市場、拓展海外商機，以及布局全方位能源。
另外，世紀風電首度啟動「半年配」，董事會通過上半年盈餘分配案，決議配發每股現金股利 6 元，現金股利發放率約 68%
paras_en: Century Wind Power (2072-TW) announced its latest financial report, with a net profit of NT$169.1 billion in the first half of 2023, a year-over-year increase of over 900%, and EPS of NT$9.3, a new high for the same period. Century Wind Power pointed out that, if the progress of the project continues in the second half, and the proportion of the water-based foundation engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project increases, it is expected that the revenue will again reach a new high this year, and the order visibility has been extended to 2029.

Century Wind Power's second-quarter revenue was NT$48.98 billion, a quarter-over-quarter increase of 24.1% and a year-over-year increase of 86.6%. The gross margin was 20.6%, a quarter-over-quarter decrease of 10.3 percentage points and a year-over-year decrease of 4.5 percentage points. The operating margin was 18.8%, a quarter-over-quarter decrease of 9.5 percentage points and a year-over-year decrease of 1.9 percentage points. The net profit was NT$7.88 billion, a quarter-over-quarter decrease of 12.7% and a year-over-year increase of 70.8%, with EPS of NT$4.11, a new high for the same period.

Century Wind Power stated that, due to the increase in the proportion of water-based foundation EPC projects, and the progress of the project as expected, the second-quarter revenue performance was boosted. However, the gross margin was affected by the fact that the EPC projects have a wider scope and higher contract values, which further diluted the second-quarter gross margin.

Century Wind Power's revenue in the first half of 2023 was NT$88.46 billion, a year-over-year increase of 63.3%. The gross margin was 25.2%, a year-over-year increase of 1.8 percentage points. The operating margin was 23.1%, a year-over-year increase of 3.3 percentage points. The net profit was NT$16.92 billion, a year-over-year increase of 91%, with EPS of NT$9.3, a new high for the same period.

Century Wind Power's board of directors approved the issuance of new shares to acquire 100% of Century Hsin (7752-TW) in June this year, and plans to rename it 'Century Energy Equipment'. The merger will be decided at the shareholders' extraordinary meeting on August 12. After the merger, Century Wind Power plans to integrate its upstream and downstream businesses, and leverage its dual bases in Taipei Port and Taichung Port to achieve synergies in key components, raw materials procurement, quality control, and project management.

Looking ahead, Century Wind Power stated that it will focus on three major development directions, including deepening its presence in the Taiwanese market, expanding overseas business opportunities, and laying out a comprehensive energy strategy.

In addition, Century Wind Power has initiated its 'half-year dividend' for the first time, with the board of directors approving the distribution of NT$6 per share in cash dividends, with a dividend payout ratio of approximately 68%.

items.title: 台股7月急跌3000點 0050淨申購逾1700億元創歷史新高
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Plunges 3,000 Points in July, 0050 Sees Record Net Buying of Over NT$17.7 Trillion
paras: 台股 7 月急跌逾 3000 點，長期資金視為絕佳進場機會，台股 ETF 單月淨申購金額突破 5500 億元，指標 ETF 元大台灣 50(0050-TW) 淨申購逾 1700 億元，寫下歷史新高，今年以來已三度單月破千億，反映投資人仍視其為逢低加碼主旋律。
7 月台股遭逢劇烈修正，市場資金轉流向「市值型布局、高股息配置」雙軌並進的成熟操作。一方面看好台股中長期發展，持續加碼市值雙雄 0050、00631L，淨申購金額分別達 1766.2 億元、477.2 億元，創下單月新高及次高的紀錄，穩居熱門 ETF 冠亞軍。
另一方面，波段恐慌也激發穩健型資金避險防禦心理，由 0056 逆勢吸引逾 376.7 億元資金流入，強勢奪下 7 月高股息 ETF 第一，扛起穩定投資信心的基石。
0050 今年已三度展現吸金千億的強勁動能，3 月市場大幅震盪，投資人視跌勢為布局契機，單月淨申購即達 1516 億元；6 月高檔整理之際，再度吸金 1685 億元。7 月面對台股新一波修正，資金再展現越跌越買的強悍韌性，顯見「成熟投資人」無畏外資調節持股，看好市場長期成長與反彈契機，把握低檔分批布局。
00631L 追求台灣 50 指數正向 2 倍績效，反彈力道更是強勁，統計史上五大單日跌幅包括 2025/4 對等關稅、2024/8 日圓升值、2018/10 美中貿易戰，以及 2020/3 全球疫情，後六個月漲幅達 24.3% 至 147.3%、後一年漲幅達 40.5% 至 314.9%，而 7/17 單日下跌 13.5% 即為第五大，後續反彈動能備受期待。
法人表示，「第四法人」持續透過 0050、00631L 等產品，資金逆勢承接大型權值股，不僅成為支撐台股的重要買盤來源，也有望成為推動下一波行情的關鍵力量。

paras_en: The Taiwan stock market plummeted over 3,000 points in July, with long-term funds viewing it as an excellent entry point. The Taiwan stock ETF saw a record net buying amount of NT$55 billion in a single month, with the index ETF, Taiex 50 (0050-TW), seeing net buying of over NT$17.7 trillion, setting a new historical high. This is the third time this year that the index ETF has seen net buying of over NT$1 trillion in a single month, reflecting investors' continued optimism about the market.

In July, the Taiwan stock market underwent a sharp correction, with funds flowing into "value-type layout, high dividend allocation" mature operations. On one hand, investors are optimistic about the long-term development of the Taiwan stock market and continue to add to their holdings of value-type stocks, including 0050 and 00631L, with net buying amounts of NT$176.6 billion and NT$47.7 billion, respectively, setting new monthly highs and second-highest records, solidifying their positions as the top two most popular ETFs.

On the other hand, the fear of short-term fluctuations has also triggered risk-averse funds to adopt a defensive strategy, with 0056 attracting over NT$37.7 billion in net buying, taking the top spot as the highest-dividend ETF in July and serving as a cornerstone for stable investment confidence.

0050 has already demonstrated its strong ability to attract net buying of over NT$1 trillion three times this year. In March, the market experienced a sharp correction, and investors saw the decline as an opportunity to add to their holdings, with net buying of NT$151.6 billion in a single month. In June, when the market was in a high-profile correction, the index ETF again attracted net buying of NT$16.85 trillion. In July, when the market underwent a new correction, funds once again demonstrated their strong ability to buy more when the market declines, showing that "mature investors" are not afraid of foreign capital adjustments and are optimistic about the market's long-term growth and rebound opportunities.

00631L is designed to track the Taiwan 50 index with a 2x return, and its rebound strength is also strong. According to historical data, the five largest single-day declines include the 2025/4 equal tax rate, the 2024/8 yen appreciation, the 2018/10 US-China trade war, and the 2020/3 global pandemic. In the six months following these events, the index ETF saw gains of 24.3% to 147.3%, and in the following year, gains of 40.5% to 314.9%. The 7/17 single-day decline of 13.5% was the fifth-largest, and the subsequent rebound potential is highly anticipated.

A professional investor noted that the "fourth institutional investor" has continued to use products such as 0050 and 00631L to absorb large-cap stocks, not only becoming an important source of buying demand for the Taiwan stock market but also potentially becoming a key driving force for the next round of market trends.

items.title: 史上第3檔萬金股！股后川湖5天漲逾40% 明日法說會釋展望
items.title_en: The 3rd “Ten‑Thousand‑Dollar Stock” in History! Stock queen Chuanhu up over 40% in five days; tomorrow’s earnings briefing to outline outlook
paras: 伺服器導軌廠川湖 (2059-TW) 於將於今 (6) 日下午公布財報，預定於明 (7) 日舉行法說會，隨著 AI 伺服器出貨強勁業績走旺，今日盤中股價衝破 10000 元關卡，高點觸及 10035 元刷新歷史新高，終場強勢大漲 630 元，收在 10100 元，漲幅高達 6.65%，正式成為台股史上第三檔萬金股。
台股史上首檔萬金股為現任股王信驊 (5274-TW)，第二檔則由半導體測試介面廠穎崴 (6515-TW) 奪下，川湖本次在法說會前夕成功跨越萬元大關並登頂股後，成為第三家加入萬金俱樂部的指標大廠。
美系外資先前出具報告指出，川湖下半年訂單能見度極為強勁，除了 AI 伺服器持續成長外，中央處理器機架、交換器機架及電源機架等設備對伺服器滑軌的採用率持續升級，加上美國廠預計於今年 9 至 10 月投產、高雄新廠規劃於 2027 年下半年加入營運，將推動產品毛利率與營益率持續改善。
paras_en: Server rail manufacturer Chuanhu (2059‑TW) will release its financial report this afternoon (the 6th) and is scheduled to hold an earnings conference tomorrow (the 7th). With strong AI server shipments driving robust performance, the stock price broke the NT$10,000 barrier during intraday trading, hitting a high of NT$10,035 to set a historic new high. It closed strongly up NT$630 at NT$10,100, a gain of 6.65%, officially becoming the third ever ten‑thousand‑dollar stock in Taiwan’s market.

The first ever ten‑thousand‑dollar stock in Taiwan was the current market leader Xin Hua (5274‑TW), the second was semiconductor test‑interface company Ying Wei (6515‑TW). Chuanhu, on the eve of its earnings briefing, successfully crossed the ten‑thousand‑dollar mark and topped the stock‑queen rank, becoming the third flagship company to join the ten‑thousand‑dollar club.

A U.S.–based foreign‑investor report previously noted that Chuanhu’s order visibility for the second half of the year is extremely strong. In addition to continued growth of AI servers, the adoption rate of server slides in CPU racks, switch racks and power racks is continuously upgrading. Moreover, a U.S. plant is expected to start production between September and October this year, and a new plant in Kaohsiung is planned to commence operations in the second half of 2027, which will drive ongoing improvement in product gross margin and operating margin.

items.title: 尖點科技深耕在地 攜手企業夥伴支持三峽小草書屋重建計畫
items.title_en: Sharp Point Technology Deepens Local Roots, Partners with Enterprises to Support the Rebuilding of Sanxia Little Grass Book House
paras: 尖點科技 (8021-TW) 積極實踐 ESG(環境、社會、公司治理) 永續願景，今 (6) 日在新北市三峽舉辦「凝聚共好、共築希望」聯合捐贈儀式。由尖點科技總經理林若萍發起，號召投資人以及證券商、往來銀行等長期合作夥伴共同響應，將聯合募捐款項正式捐贈予總公司所在地三峽的「小草書屋」。
此一捐助將協助三峽小草書屋重建計畫的陪伴空間重建及未來營運，透過串聯企業、金融機構及投資夥伴的力量，共同守護在地孩子成長，實踐永續共好的理念。
尖點科技與小草書屋的緣分開始於 2016 年。因認同小草書屋長期深耕三峽、陪伴在地孩子成長的理念，尖點科技 10 年來持續支持課後陪伴師資及孩子們的單車環島圓夢計畫，希望陪伴更多孩子建立自信、勇敢追夢，迎向未來。這份長期陪伴，也讓尖點與小草書屋建立深厚的信任，共同守護更多孩子成長。

林若萍表示，身為三峽在地企業，尖點科技十 10 年來一路陪伴小草孩子們共同成長，今年得知小草書屋因建物老舊啟動重建計畫時，便毫不猶豫決定投入，由公司率先捐助，並發起聯合募捐，邀請更多合作夥伴共同參與。最令人感動的是，不只是尖點科技的投入，更是多位投資人、企業夥伴及金融夥伴在短時間內共同響應，讓每一份善意都匯聚成支持孩子成長的力量。這份共同投入，也讓公益從一家企業的力量，擴展為一群夥伴共同守護在地孩子的行動。
今天捐贈儀式一改傳統捐贈合照形式，特別設計「共築家園．永續愛心牆」啟動儀式。包括尖點科技及所有參與捐贈的合作夥伴，共同將象徵一磚一瓦的磁吸積木貼上舞台中央的小草書屋藍圖。隨著最後一塊象徵攜手共好的核心拼圖完成，也象徵各界共同為三峽孩子築起一座充滿希望的新家。
小草書屋代表也於儀式中表達誠摯感謝，表示這筆善款不僅將加速新書屋重建，改善孩子們的學習與陪伴環境，更代表社會各界對長期陪伴工作的認同與支持，讓團隊更有力量持續陪伴每一位孩子成長。
近年來，ESG 已成為企業永續經營的重要方向，而尖點科技認為，永續不只是企業自身的努力，更需要攜手合作夥伴，共同發揮正向的社會影響力。本次聯合募捐，不僅為三峽在地帶來實質改變，也展現上市公司透過串聯利害關係人，共同投入社會公益的具體實踐。
尖點科技表示，本次聯合募捐只是開始，也希望透過企業拋磚引玉，帶動更多社會力量投入在地公益。未來將持續關注小草書屋重建進度，並支持其後續發展，為社會創造長遠且正向的永續價值。
paras_en: Sharp Point Technology (8021-TW) is actively implementing its ESG (environment, social, governance) sustainability vision, and today (the 6th) held a joint donation ceremony in Sanxia, New Taipei City titled “Gathering for Mutual Benefit, Building Hope Together.” Initiated by Sharp Point’s general manager Lin Ruoping, the event called on investors, securities firms, banks and other long‑term partners to jointly donate the raised funds to the “Little Grass Book House” in Sanxia, where the company’s headquarters is located.

The donation will support the reconstruction of the companion space for the Little Grass Book House rebuilding project and its future operations, leveraging the combined strength of corporations, financial institutions and investment partners to protect the growth of local children and realize a sustainable, mutually beneficial concept.

Sharp Point’s relationship with the Little Grass Book House began in 2016. Sharing the book house’s long‑term commitment to nurturing local children in Sanxia, Sharp Point has, for ten years, continuously supported after‑school mentors and the children’s dream‑fulfilling bicycle‑around‑the‑island program, hoping to help more children build confidence, chase their dreams and face the future. This long‑term companionship has forged deep trust between Sharp Point and the book house, jointly safeguarding more children’s development.

Lin Ruoping said that as a local Sanxia enterprise, Sharp Point has accompanied the Little Grass children for ten years. When the book house announced a rebuilding plan due to its aging facilities, the company did not hesitate to act, leading the donation and launching a joint fundraising effort, inviting more partners to join. What moved her most was that not only Sharp Point contributed, but many investors, corporate and financial partners responded quickly, turning every act of goodwill into a force that supports children’s growth. This collective effort expands philanthropy from a single company to a group of partners protecting local children together.

Today’s donation ceremony broke from the traditional group‑photo format, featuring a specially designed “Building a Home · Sustainable Love Wall” activation. Sharp Point and all participating partners placed magnetic building‑block bricks—symbolizing each brick and tile—onto a blueprint of the Little Grass Book House at the center of the stage. With the final piece of the core puzzle, representing joint goodwill, completed, it symbolized all parties together constructing a hopeful new home for Sanxia’s children.

The Little Grass Book House representative expressed sincere gratitude at the ceremony, noting that the funds will not only accelerate the new building’s reconstruction and improve the learning and companion environment for the children, but also reflect society’s recognition and support for the long‑term nurturing work, empowering the team to continue supporting every child’s growth.

In recent years, ESG has become a key direction for corporate sustainable management, and Sharp Point believes sustainability is not only the company’s own effort but also requires collaboration with partners to generate positive social impact. This joint fundraising not only brings tangible change to Sanxia but also demonstrates how a listed company can mobilize stakeholders to collectively invest in social welfare.

Sharp Point stated that this joint fundraising is just the beginning and hopes to spark more societal involvement in local philanthropy through corporate leadership. It will continue to monitor the reconstruction progress of the Little Grass Book House and support its subsequent development, creating long‑term, positive sustainable value for society.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉權值股疲軟、千金股唱高調 跌214點守住季線 中止日K連4紅
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market: Value Stocks Weaken, Penny Stocks Surge, Index Holds Above Seasonal Line
paras: 台股今 (6) 日在受電子、金融權值股疲弱，開低震盪走低，早盤下跌逾 600 點，最低來到 4 萬 4 千點附近，以鋼鐵、散熱、高價股及 7 月營收亮眼的中小型股表現較佳，盤中隨著權值股跌勢回穩，終場下跌 214.9 點或 0.48％，收 44,396.7 點，守住季線，但中止日 K 連 4 紅，成交量較前日縮減至 9,403.91 億元。
櫃買 (OTC) 市場部分，今日表現優於集中市場，上漲 1.99％，日 K 連收 5 紅。
在權值股部分，台積電 (2330-TW) 今日開低走低，最後一盤遭砍 4,217 張，跌 1.66％或 40 元，收 2,365 元；聯發科 (2454-TW) 跌 2％，跌破 4,000 元大關；鴻海 (2317-TW)7 月營收亮眼，漲 2.32％；群創 (3481-TW) 漲 4.6％、台達電 (2308-TW) 漲 1.82％。
金融權值股今日則表現無力，壽險雙雄富邦金 (2882-TW)、國泰金 (2881-TW) 跌於 2-3％，凱基金 (2883-TW)、台新新光金 (2887-TW) 跌 3％以上，元大金 (2885-TW) 跌 2.3％。
鋼鐵股部分，因全球鋼鐵市場進到第 3 季展開修正，近期因浮現四大築底訊號，第 4 季景氣回升的可能性大增，激勵東和鋼鐵 (2006-TW) 亮燈鎖漲停、大成鋼 (2027-TW) 漲逾 4％、新鋼 (2032-TW) 漲逾 8％、新光鋼 (2031-TW) 漲半根漲停板。
散熱族群受惠 AI 伺服器持續升級、高功耗晶片帶動液冷散熱需求快速攀升，今日盤中獲資金點火，包括富世達 (6805-TW)、建準 (2421-TW)、邁科 (6831-TW)、雙鴻 (3324-TW) 齊嗨收漲停，奇鋐 (3017-TW) 漲 7％以上，建策 (3653-TW)、泰碩 (3338 -TW) 大漲 2.5％以上。
高價股部分，除了萬金股王信驊 (5274-TW) 大漲 4.56％，股后川湖 (2059-TW) 也大漲 6.65％，收 10,100 元也晉升萬金股，成為台股第 3 檔股價衝破 1 萬元的個股。今天千金股增至 49 檔，盤中多檔 9 檔亮燈漲停。
分析師表示，今日台股拉回修正，量能也受到萎縮，主要是權值股受到壓抑，在量減價跌下，短線正乖離較大，投資人可以關注 7 月最新營收，半年季財報及近期法說會的消息，今日類股大多為跌深類股展開反彈趨勢，籌碼上可留意外資在期貨空單上的布局。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market declined today, with value stocks weakening and penny stocks surging. The market opened lower and fell by over 600 points, with a low of around 44,400. However, the market rebounded in the afternoon, with value stocks stabilizing, and the index closed down 214.9 points or 0.48%, at 44,396.7. The market held above the seasonal line, but the daily K line ended in red for the fourth consecutive day, with a trading volume of 94.0391 billion NT dollars, down from the previous day.
The over-the-counter (OTC) market performed better than the main market, rising 1.99% and closing in red for the fifth consecutive day.

In the value stock sector, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC, 2330-TW) opened lower and fell by 1.66% or 40 NT dollars, closing at 2,365 NT dollars. MediaTek (2454-TW) fell by 2%, breaking the 4,000 NT dollar barrier. Hon Hai Precision Industry (2317-TW) reported strong July sales, rising 2.32%. Group Technology (3481-TW) rose 4.6%, and Delta Electronics (2308-TW) rose 1.82%.

Financial value stocks were weak today, with Fubon Financial Holding (2882-TW) and CTBC Financial Holding (2881-TW) falling by 2-3%. Cathay Financial Holding (2883-TW) and Shin Kong Financial Holding (2887-TW) fell by over 3%, and E.Sun Financial Holding (2885-TW) fell by 2.3%.

The steel stock sector was boosted by the global steel market's entry into the third quarter, with a correction underway. The recent emergence of four major bottom signals has increased the possibility of a fourth-quarter economic rebound, leading to a surge in steel stocks. Eastern Steel (2006-TW) rose to the limit, while Dalian Steel (2027-TW) rose over 4%, New Steel (2032-TW) rose over 8%, and New Steel (2031-TW) rose half a point to the limit.

The heat dissipation sector benefited from the continuous upgrade of AI servers and the rapid increase in demand for liquid cooling heat dissipation due to high-power chips. The sector received funding during the day, with stocks such as Fuxida (6805-TW), Jianzhun (2421-TW), Maike (6831-TW), and Shuanghong (3324-TW) all closing at the limit. Qifeng (3017-TW) rose by over 7%, while Jianshe (3653-TW) and Taishan (3338-TW) rose by over 2.5%.

The high-priced stock sector saw a surge in stocks such as Shin Yeh (5274-TW), which rose 4.56%, and Shanghui (2059-TW), which rose 6.65% and closed at 10,100 NT dollars, becoming the third-tier stock to break the 10,000 NT dollar barrier. Today, there are 49 stocks with a market value of over 1 billion NT dollars, with 9 stocks rising to the limit during the day.

Analysts believe that the market today is correcting, with a decrease in trading volume. The main reason is that value stocks are being suppressed, leading to a large deviation in the short term. Investors can focus on the latest July sales, semi-annual financial reports, and recent earnings calls. Today, most stocks are in the decline category, with a trend of rebounding. Investors should pay attention to the layout of foreign investors in futures contracts.

items.title: 世紀風電上半年EPS 9.3元創同期高 訂單能見度看至2029年
items.title_en: Century Wind Power Reports Record-High EPS of NT$9.3 in First Half of 2023
paras: 世紀風電 (2072-TW) 公告最新財報，累計今年上半年稅後純益 16.91 億元，年增超過 9 成，每股純益 9.3 元，創歷史同期新高。世紀風電指出，下半年工程進度如其推進，加上水下基礎統包工程 (EPC) 比重提升，看好今年營收再創高，且訂單能見度已看至 2029 年。
世紀風電第二季營收 48.98 億元，季增 24.1%，年增 86.6%；毛利率 20.6%，季減 10.3 個百分點，年減 4.5 個百分點；營益率 18.8%，季減 9.5 個百分點，年減 1.9 個百分點；稅後純益 7.88 億，季減 12.7%，年增 70.8%，每股純益 4.11 元，創歷史同期新高。
世紀風電表示，受惠水下基礎 EPC 比重提升，且工程進度如其認列，推升第二季營收表現。毛利率方面，則因 EPC 專案涵蓋範疇較廣，加上合約總值較高，進一步稀釋第二季毛利水準。
世紀風電累計今年上半年營收 88.46 億元，年增 63.3%；毛利率 25.2%，年增 1.8 個百分點；營益率 23.1%，年增 3.3 個百分點；稅後純益 16.92 億元，年增 91%，每股純益 9.3 元，寫歷史同期新高。
世紀風電董事會今年 6 月通過以發行新股方式，取得世紀樺欣 (7752-TW)100% 股權，並擬更名為「世紀能源設備」，將於 8 月 12 日股東臨時會決議。整併後，計畫透過上下游整合，世紀風電可完整發揮台北港與台中港的雙基地優勢，未來在關鍵零組件掌握、原物料共同採購、品質控管與工程管理可望發揮綜效。
展望後市，世紀風電表示將鎖定三大發展方向，包括深耕台灣市場、拓展海外商機，以及布局全方位能源。
另外，世紀風電首度啟動「半年配」，董事會通過上半年盈餘分配案，決議配發每股現金股利 6 元，現金股利發放率約 68%
paras_en: Century Wind Power (2072-TW) announced its latest financial report, with a net profit of NT$169.1 billion in the first half of 2023, a year-over-year increase of over 900%, and EPS of NT$9.3, a new high for the same period. Century Wind Power pointed out that, if the progress of the project continues in the second half, and the proportion of the water-based foundation engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project increases, it is expected that the revenue will again reach a new high this year, and the order visibility has been extended to 2029.

Century Wind Power's second-quarter revenue was NT$48.98 billion, a quarter-over-quarter increase of 24.1% and a year-over-year increase of 86.6%. The gross margin was 20.6%, a quarter-over-quarter decrease of 10.3 percentage points and a year-over-year decrease of 4.5 percentage points. The operating margin was 18.8%, a quarter-over-quarter decrease of 9.5 percentage points and a year-over-year decrease of 1.9 percentage points. The net profit was NT$7.88 billion, a quarter-over-quarter decrease of 12.7% and a year-over-year increase of 70.8%, with EPS of NT$4.11, a new high for the same period.

Century Wind Power stated that, due to the increase in the proportion of water-based foundation EPC projects, and the progress of the project as expected, the second-quarter revenue performance was boosted. However, the gross margin was affected by the fact that the EPC projects have a wider scope and higher contract values, which further diluted the second-quarter gross margin.

Century Wind Power's revenue in the first half of 2023 was NT$88.46 billion, a year-over-year increase of 63.3%. The gross margin was 25.2%, a year-over-year increase of 1.8 percentage points. The operating margin was 23.1%, a year-over-year increase of 3.3 percentage points. The net profit was NT$16.92 billion, a year-over-year increase of 91%, with EPS of NT$9.3, a new high for the same period.

Century Wind Power's board of directors approved the issuance of new shares to acquire 100% of Century Hsin (7752-TW) in June this year, and plans to rename it 'Century Energy Equipment'. The merger will be decided at the shareholders' extraordinary meeting on August 12. After the merger, Century Wind Power plans to integrate its upstream and downstream businesses, and leverage its dual bases in Taipei Port and Taichung Port to achieve synergies in key components, raw materials procurement, quality control, and project management.

Looking ahead, Century Wind Power stated that it will focus on three major development directions, including deepening its presence in the Taiwanese market, expanding overseas business opportunities, and laying out a comprehensive energy strategy.

In addition, Century Wind Power has initiated its 'half-year dividend' for the first time, with the board of directors approving the distribution of NT$6 per share in cash dividends, with a dividend payout ratio of approximately 68%.

items.title: 宏碁施振榮看好NEO Semiconductor 突破AI記憶體瓶頸帶來新方向
items.title_en: Acer Founder Stan Shih Optimistic About NEO Semiconductor's Breakthrough in AI Memory Bottleneck Offering New Direction
paras: 由矽谷華人許富菖創立的 AI 記憶體公司 NEO Semiconductor，今 () 日於全球記憶體與儲存產業年度盛會 FMS 2026，發表新一代 AI 晶片內建記憶體技術 X-SRAM，並同步推出 NEO.AI 平台。宏碁 (2353-TW) 創辦人暨台積電前董事施振榮表示，看好 NEO Semiconductor 持續推動 AI 記憶體創新，並期待這些突破為台灣及全球半導體產業帶來更多可能。
該平台整合 X-SRAM 與 3D X-DRAM 兩項核心技術，致力解決 AI 晶片內建記憶體容量不足，以及高頻寬記憶體（HBM）容量與功耗限制等兩大挑戰。同時獲得國際專家評審肯定，不僅彰顯 NEO Semiconductor 在 AI 記憶體創新的領先地位，也進一步提升公司於全球半導體產業的能見度。
隨著生成式 AI 與大型語言模型快速發展，AI 晶片對記憶體容量的需求持續攀升。然而，傳統 SRAM 於先進製程已逐漸接近微縮極限，使晶片內建快取容量成長受限，導致 HBM 存取增加、功耗與成本同步提升，形成日益嚴重的 AI Memory Wall。

NEO Semiconductor 表示，X-SRAM 採用全新記憶體架構，在完全相容先進 Nanosheet CMOS 製程下，可提供最高 5 倍於傳統 SRAM 的記憶體密度，使 AI 晶片內建記憶體容量可望由目前約 200 至 400MB 提升至 1 至 2GB，並預估降低 HBM 存取功耗約 50% 至 80%。此外，X-SRAM 亦具備未來發展 3D SRAM 的潛力，可望將記憶體密度進一步提升 20 倍以上。
許富菖亦於主題演講中分享 3D X-DRAM 最新進展。該技術採用創新的 3D NAND-like 架構，突破傳統 DRAM 微縮限制，並已與國立陽明交通大學產學創新研究學院（IAIS）及國家實驗研究院台灣半導體研究中心（TSRI）完成概念驗證（POC）測試晶片開發，目前正持續朝商業化邁進。
宏碁集團創辦人暨台積電前董事施振榮表示，AI 正快速改變全球產業，而記憶體將是支撐下一階段 AI 發展的重要關鍵。很高興看到 NEO Semiconductor 持續推出 X-SRAM 與 NEO.AI 等創新技術，為突破 AI 記憶體瓶頸提供新的方向，也期待這些創新能為台灣及全球半導體產業帶來更多可能。

NEO Semiconductor 創辦人暨執行長許富菖表示，當傳統記憶體逐漸接近物理極限，AI Memory Wall 已成為下一代 AI 發展的重要挑戰。透過 NEO.AI 平台整合 X-SRAM 與 3D X-DRAM，我們希望同時提升晶片內建記憶體與 HBM 容量，打造更高效、更具擴充性的 AI 記憶體架構。我們也正積極尋求與全球晶圓代工夥伴合作，共同推動 X-SRAM 技術開發，加速下一代 AI 記憶體技術商業化，攜手推動 AI 運算邁向新的世代。
paras_en: Founded by Silicon Valley Chinese entrepreneur Hsu Fu-Chang, AI memory company NEO Semiconductor today announced its next‑generation AI chip‑in‑memory technology X‑SRAM and launched the NEO.AI platform at the global memory and storage industry’s annual event FMS 2026. Acer (2353‑TW) founder and former TSMC director Stan Shih said he is confident in NEO Semiconductor’s continued AI memory innovation and looks forward to these breakthroughs creating more possibilities for Taiwan and the global semiconductor industry.

The platform integrates the two core technologies X‑SRAM and 3D X‑DRAM, aiming to solve two major challenges: insufficient on‑chip memory capacity for AI chips and the capacity and power‑consumption limits of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM). International expert reviewers praised the work, highlighting NEO Semiconductor’s leading position in AI memory innovation and boosting the company’s visibility in the worldwide semiconductor sector.

As generative AI and large language models rapidly evolve, AI chips’ demand for memory capacity keeps climbing. Traditional SRAM is approaching its scaling limits in advanced processes, restricting on‑chip cache growth and forcing greater HBM usage, which raises power consumption and cost, intensifying the AI Memory Wall problem.

NEO Semiconductor says X‑SRAM uses a brand‑new memory architecture fully compatible with advanced nanosheet CMOS processes, delivering up to five times the density of conventional SRAM. This could raise on‑chip AI memory from the current roughly 200‑400 MB to 1‑2 GB and cut HBM access power by about 50‑80%. X‑SRAM also has the potential to evolve into 3D SRAM, which could increase density by more than 20‑fold.

Hsu Fu‑Chang also shared the latest progress on 3D X‑DRAM during his keynote. The technology employs an innovative 3D NAND‑like structure that overcomes traditional DRAM scaling limits and has completed a proof‑of‑concept test chip in collaboration with the Institute of Applied Innovation and Science at National Yang‑Ming Chiao‑Tung University and the Taiwan Semiconductor Research Institute of the National Applied Research Laboratories. Commercialization efforts are now underway.

Acer Group founder and former TSMC director Stan Shih noted that AI is rapidly reshaping global industries and that memory will be a crucial pillar for the next stage of AI development. He expressed enthusiasm for NEO Semiconductor’s continued rollout of X‑SRAM and NEO.AI, which provide new directions for overcoming AI memory bottlenecks, and he looks forward to these innovations creating more opportunities for Taiwan and the worldwide semiconductor sector.

NEO Semiconductor founder and CEO Hsu Fu‑Chang said that as traditional memory approaches its physical limits, the AI Memory Wall has become a key challenge for next‑generation AI. By integrating X‑SRAM and 3D X‑DRAM on the NEO.AI platform, they aim to boost both on‑chip memory and HBM capacity, creating a more efficient and scalable AI memory architecture. The company is actively seeking partnerships with global foundries to co‑develop X‑SRAM technology, accelerate commercialization of next‑generation AI memory, and jointly drive AI computing into a new era.

items.title: 記憶體股血流成河 馬斯克一句話救信心：供不應求才剛開始
items.title_en: Memory Stocks Flooded with Blood, Musk’s One Sentence Restores Confidence: Supply Shortage Is Just Beginning
paras: 美國兩大記憶體廠商 SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 與威騰電子 (WDC-US) 雖公布亮眼財報，但業績展望未達市場高期待，引發投資人失望，兩家公司股價週三（5 日）美股盤後雙雙重挫。記憶體股賣壓隨後蔓延至亞洲，南韓「記憶體雙雄」SK 海力士 (000660KS) 與三星電子 (005930KS) 週四分別下跌 10.3% 及 6.3%，日本快閃記憶體大廠鎧俠股價也暴跌逾 10%，市場憂慮 AI 帶動的記憶體行情面臨獲利預期修正壓力。
然而，在 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克看來，投資者完全不應為記憶體的需求感到擔憂，因為在 AI 熱潮中，最大的瓶頸之一正是記憶體。他明確表示，記憶體晶片的需求增長速度遠遠超過了供應增速。
馬斯克對記憶體晶片的需求狀況具備很強的發言權，因為特斯拉和 SpaceX 均是記憶體晶片的重要買家。特斯拉和 SpaceX 的未來發展都高度依賴於人工智能，並且都在大舉斥資採購 AI 晶片、記憶體晶片以及其它用於數據中心的 AI 基礎設施，這意味著馬斯克擁有洞察記憶體需求的絕佳視角。
SpaceX 週三公佈了 IPO 後的首份業績，隨後的電話會議展示了關於火箭、機器人、星艦和衛星的宏大計劃。然而，對於緊盯半導體股票、每日跟隨晶片股行情變動的市場而言，真正抓住人們眼球的是馬斯克關於記憶體晶片的深刻言論。
「目前的限制因素是記憶體，」馬斯克直言，「記憶體產量每年增長約 20%。通常來說，這對任何龐大且成熟的行業而言，這一速度已經非常驚人。但請想一想：需求每年增長 20% 嗎？不，需求每年增長 200% 甚至更多。所以，當需求的增長速度遠超供給時，基礎經濟學原理告訴我們，價格應該上漲，而不是下跌。」
馬斯克的這一觀點，與一些分析師近期提出的理論形成了鮮明對比。
此前，部分分析師認為 SK 海力士等公司的產能擴張，可能會導致記憶體晶片供過於求並壓低價格。整個夏季，市場都在激烈爭論半導體超級週期能否延續，投資者對 AI 資本開支熱潮能持續多久充滿疑慮。
在 7 月遭受重創後，進入 8 月晶片類股行情雖有所回暖，但當前圍繞晶片類股的市場情緒仍然十分脆弱。由於 Sandisk 和威騰電子的業績，未能滿足投資者的超高期待，週四亞洲市場上的記憶體族群才出現了大幅下跌。
儘管 SanDisk 與威騰電子的營收和利潤均超出市場預期，但 Sandisk 的業績指引略微不及市場預期，而威騰電子的指引也未能帶來任何驚喜，相較於希捷科技上週給出的業績指引要遜色得多。
高盛指出，過高的市場預期令兩家公司的股價難以從亮眼業績中獲益，導致業績公佈後兩檔股票雙雙承壓下跌。馬斯克此次的公開表態，或許能為動盪不安的記憶體晶片市場注入一劑強心針。
paras_en: U.S. memory giants SanDisk (SNDKV-US) and Western Digital (WDC-US) posted impressive earnings, but their outlook fell short of lofty market expectations, disappointing investors and sending both stocks sharply lower after Wednesday’s (the 5th) U.S. market close. The sell‑off in memory stocks then spread to Asia, where South Korea’s “memory twins” SK Hynix (000660KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930KS) fell 10.3% and 6.3% respectively on Thursday, and Japanese flash‑memory leader Kioxia saw its shares plunge more than 10%, as the market worries that AI‑driven memory demand is now facing profit‑margin revisions.

However, SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk argues investors should not worry about memory demand at all, because one of the biggest bottlenecks in the AI boom is precisely memory. He stated clearly that the growth rate of demand for memory chips far outpaces the growth rate of supply.

Musk’s view on memory‑chip demand carries weight because both Tesla and SpaceX are major buyers of memory chips. Their future development is heavily dependent on artificial intelligence, and they are pouring money into AI chips, memory chips and other AI‑infrastructure for data centers, giving Musk an excellent perspective on memory demand.

SpaceX released its first post‑IPO earnings on Wednesday, and the subsequent earnings call highlighted ambitious plans for rockets, robots, Starship and satellites. Yet for a market that watches semiconductor stocks and chip‑stock movements daily, the real headline‑grabber was Musk’s pointed comments on memory chips.

“The current constraint is memory,” Musk said bluntly. “Memory production is growing about 20% a year. For any large, mature industry that’s already a remarkable rate. But think about this: does demand grow 20% a year? No – demand is growing 200% or more each year. So when demand outpaces supply that dramatically, basic economics tells us prices should rise, not fall.”
Musk’s viewpoint stands in stark contrast to theories recently put forward by some analysts.

Earlier, several analysts warned that capacity expansions by companies such as SK Hynix could lead to oversupply of memory chips and push prices down. Throughout the summer, the market has fiercely debated whether the semiconductor super‑cycle can continue, and investors remain skeptical about how long the AI‑capex frenzy will last.

After a heavy hit in July, the chip sector showed some recovery in August, but sentiment around chip stocks remains fragile. Because SanDisk’s and Western Digital’s results failed to meet investors’ sky‑high expectations, the memory segment in Asian markets slumped sharply on Thursday.

Although both SanDisk and Western Digital posted revenue and profit above market forecasts, SanDisk’s guidance fell slightly short of expectations and Western Digital’s outlook offered no surprises, lagging far behind the guidance Seagate gave last week.

Goldman Sachs noted that overly lofty market expectations made it hard for the two companies’ shares to benefit from their strong results, causing both stocks to slide after the announcements. Musk’s public remarks may provide a much‑needed boost to the turbulent memory‑chip market.
