items.title_en: Situational Awareness Fund Re-enters Investment Market After Near Collapse
paras: 前 OpenAI 研究員、現年 25 歲的華爾街新晉投資者 Leopold Aschenbrenner，其執掌的避險基金 Situational Awareness 在經歷了瀕臨崩潰僅僅幾天之後，已經重返投資市場，對一家非上市公司押注 4 億美元。

在 7 月初，Situational Awareness 的資產規模曾高達 450 億美元，但隨著其持有的上市科技股價值迅速縮水，引發了華爾街貸款機構大規模追繳保證金。為了應對資金壓力，Aschenbrenner 一度考慮出售其引以為傲的私募股權，如 Anthropic、Fluidstack 與 MatX 等公司的股份。最終，他與 Ken Griffin 旗下的 Citadel 達成協議，出售了大部分的上市股票組合，以償還貸款並保住私募股權持倉。
這也讓他付出了極大的代價，截至上周四，這支基金的資產規模已暴跌至約 100 億美元，早先槓桿押注賺取的巨額收益，在保證金追繳令的追殺下已付之一炬。
儘管基金元氣大傷，但 Aschenbrenner 隨即展現了重返市場的決心。據知情人士透露，基金已於本周二向一家非上市公司投資 4 億美元，這是繼上個月投入 1 億美元後的追加投資。雖然目前尚不清楚這筆資金具體流向投資組合中的哪家公司，但此舉被視為他試圖透過長期價值投資來重建基金的初步信號。
Situational Awareness 的投資者結構特殊，大多為舊金山灣區的富裕人士與家族辦公室，包括 D1 Capital 創辦人 Dan Sundheim 等知名大咖。儘管經歷劇震，目前尚未出現大規模撤資跡象。
Aschenbrenner 在致投資者的信中承諾，他幾乎所有的個人資產都投入了這支基金，並將從此次經驗中吸取教訓，成為更強大的投資人。
值得一提的是，在基金動盪最劇烈的那個周六，Aschenbrenner 於加州卡梅爾谷完成婚禮，其妻子現任 Anthropic 執行長的幕僚長。這場被譽為「AI 皇室婚禮」的慶典與基金的生存保衛戰同時上演，戲劇性十足。目前他已取消蜜月，親自與每位擔憂的投資者進行電話溝通以安撫情緒。
paras_en: Leopold Aschenbrenner, a 25-year-old former OpenAI researcher and new investor on Wall Street, has led his hedge fund Situational Awareness back into the investment market after a near-collapse, betting $4 billion on a private company.

In early July, Situational Awareness had assets of $45 billion, but the value of its publicly traded tech stocks plummeted, triggering a massive margin call from Wall Street lenders. To address the funding pressure, Aschenbrenner considered selling his prized private equity stakes, including those in Anthropic, Fluidstack, and MatX. Ultimately, he reached an agreement with Ken Griffin's Citadel to sell most of his public stock portfolio to repay loans and preserve his private equity holdings.
This came at a great cost, as the fund's assets had plummeted to around $10 billion by last Thursday, with the huge profits from its earlier leveraged bets wiped out by the margin calls.

Despite the fund's severe losses, Aschenbrenner quickly demonstrated his determination to re-enter the market. According to insiders, the fund invested $4 billion in a private company on Tuesday, following an additional $1 billion investment last month. Although it is unclear which company received the funding, this move is seen as a sign of his attempt to rebuild the fund through long-term value investing.

Situational Awareness has a unique investor structure, primarily consisting of wealthy individuals and family offices from the San Francisco Bay Area, including D1 Capital founder Dan Sundheim. Despite the turmoil, there are no signs of massive withdrawals yet.
In a letter to investors, Aschenbrenner pledged that nearly all of his personal assets are invested in the fund and that he will learn from this experience to become a stronger investor.

Notably, during the most turbulent week for the fund, Aschenbrenner got married in California's Carmel Valley, with his wife serving as the chief of staff to the CEO of Anthropic. This 'AI royal wedding' took place simultaneously with the fund's survival battle, making for a dramatic scene. Aschenbrenner has now canceled his honeymoon and is personally calling concerned investors to reassure them.

items.title: 上周按兵不動是觀察期！Fed庫克放鷹：通膨若不退準備支持升息
items.title_en: Last Week’s Hold Was an Observation Period! Fed’s Cook Takes a Hawkish Stance: Ready to Support Rate Hikes if Inflation Doesn’t Cool
paras: 美國聯準會 (Fed) 理事庫克 (Lisa Cook) 周三 (6 日) 表示，她認為上周沒有必要升息，但若通膨未能很快降溫，她已準備支持進一步升息。 ，以因應「仍然過高」的物價壓力。
庫克在阿拉斯加安克拉治經濟發展公司 (Anchorage Economic Development Corporation) 舉辦的 2026 年經濟午餐會發表演說，她說道：「如果通膨沒有很快開始降溫，我已準備好在必要時採取升息行動。」
她認為在 Fed 雙重使命中，目前通膨風險高於就業風險。若有必要升息抑制物價，她也會同時評估對整體經濟的影響。
她說：「如果有必要讓通膨回落，我將支持升息，但也有可能最後不需要。」

抗通膨空間正在縮小

庫克表示，由於美國通膨已連續五年高於 Fed 設定的 2% 目標，通膨預期逐漸根深蒂固的風險正持續升高。根據 Fed 偏好的個人消費支出 (PCE) 物價指數，6 月通膨年增率為 3.7%。
庫克警告，通膨可能逐漸反映在企業定價與薪資形成過程中，使 Fed 日後壓低通膨的難度提高。她說：「通膨高於目標的時間愈長，這種情況發生的可能性就愈高。因此，在目前環境下，我們沒有等待更久的餘裕。」

上周支持利率不變的原因

庫克並解釋，她上周支持維持利率不變，主因是目前推升通膨的幾項因素未必會持續。去年開始實施的關稅大多已反映在物價上，由於比較基期墊高，未來對通膨的推升效果可能逐步減弱。
她也提到，中東衝突推升油價，但市場普遍預估油價年底前將回落。此外，目前因人工智慧 (AI) 需求帶動而飆升的相關零組件價格，未來也可望隨供應鏈調整而下降。
她說：「因此，我認為目前適合先按兵不動，觀察這些因素如何演變。」

內部鷹聲起

Fed 上周以九比三決議維持聯邦基金利率目標區間於 3.50-3.75% 不變，但已有三位地區聯準銀行總裁主張立即升息 1 碼，以抑制通膨，分別是哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack)、卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari) 和蘿根(Lorie Logan)。
相較之下，Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 仍未針對未來利率路徑提供明確指引，也未詳細說明其貨幣政策決策邏輯。
卡什卡利周三接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，為抑制通膨，現在應開始循序漸進升息，但並非主張大幅提高利率。
另一方面，堪薩斯城聯準銀行總裁施密德 (Jeff Schmid) 周二晚間表示，目前通膨仍過高，要讓通膨回落仍需更高利率支撐。
施密德說：「考量需求與投資依然強勁，我不認為目前貨幣政策立場具有抑制性。」他今年並非聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 具有投票權的成員。
paras_en: Fed Governor Lisa Cook said on Wednesday (the 6th) that she believes there was no need to raise rates last week, but if inflation does not cool quickly she is prepared to support further hikes to address "still too high" price pressures.

Cook made the remarks at a 2026 economic luncheon hosted by the Anchorage Economic Development Corporation, stating, "If inflation does not start to cool quickly, I am ready to take rate‑hiking action when necessary."
She said that within the Fed’s dual mandate, the inflation risk currently outweighs the employment risk, and if a hike is needed to curb prices she will also assess the impact on the broader economy.
She added, "If it is necessary to bring inflation down, I will support a rate hike, but it may ultimately not be needed."

The anti‑inflationary space is shrinking. Cook noted that U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s 2% target for five consecutive years, and the risk of entrenched inflation expectations is rising. According to the Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, June’s annual inflation rate was 3.7%.

Cook warned that inflation could gradually become embedded in corporate pricing and wage‑setting, making it harder for the Fed to bring it down later. She said, "The longer inflation stays above target, the more likely this scenario becomes. Therefore, we do not have the luxury of waiting any longer in the current environment."

Why she supported keeping rates steady last week. Cook explained that the main factors driving inflation may not persist. Most tariffs imposed since last year have already been reflected in prices, and because the base period was higher, their inflationary impact is likely to fade.

She also mentioned that Middle‑East conflicts have pushed oil prices up, but markets generally expect oil to retreat before year‑end. In addition, the surge in component prices driven by AI demand is expected to ease as supply chains adjust.
She said, "Therefore, I think it is appropriate now to hold steady and observe how these factors evolve."

Internal hawks emerge. The Fed voted 9‑3 last week to keep the federal funds target range at 3.50‑3.75% but three regional bank presidents—Beth Hammack, Neel Kashkari and Lorie Logan—advocated an immediate one‑point hike to curb inflation.
In contrast, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has not provided clear guidance on the future rate path nor detailed the logic behind his monetary‑policy decisions.
Kashkari told CNBC on Wednesday that to curb inflation the Fed should now begin a gradual series of rate hikes, though he does not call for a large jump in rates.
Meanwhile, Jeff Schmid, president of the Kansas City Fed, said on Tuesday night that inflation remains too high and that bringing it down will require higher rates for support.
Schmid said, "Given that demand and investment remain strong, I do not think the current monetary stance is restrictive." He is not a voting member of the Federal Open Market Committee this year.

items.title: 戴蒙示警市場槓桿過高「總會有人擾亂市場」
items.title_en: Dimon Warns Market Leverage Too High “Someone Will Always Disrupt the Market”
paras: 摩根大通 (JPMorgan) 執行長戴蒙 (Jamie Dimon) 警告，金融市場整體槓桿水準依然偏高，投資人應留意部分隱藏性借貸，可能在市場震盪時放大衝擊。
他接受《CNBC》專訪時談到，「融資餘額 (margin debt) 已創下歷史新高。還有許多你看不到的融資，因為它們並不被稱作融資餘額，而是以其他名稱存在。這類槓桿有些是公開的，有些則是隱藏的。」
戴蒙指出，這些槓桿透過主要經紀商、避險基金、ETF 及美債套利交易等方式取得的借貸。「市場整體槓桿相當高。」
近來市場再度關注金融市場槓桿風險，原因包括美股估值偏高、避險基金槓桿接近歷史高點，以及大規模美債基差交易，都引發市場擔憂金融體系部分領域的脆弱性可能正在累積。
戴蒙表示，高槓桿意味著只要單一投資人或基金出現問題，就可能引發更廣泛的市場波動。「當市場存在這種情況時，就更有可能出現某個人迅速擾亂市場，而市場參與者也會因此受到驚嚇。」
專注 AI 投資的避險基金 Situational Awareness 近期因高槓桿押注科技股失利，觸發追加保證金，被迫出售大部分上市股票投資組合，蒙受重大損失。
當被問及此事件時，身為 Situational Awareness 主經紀商之一的摩根大通，戴蒙表示，這起事件反而證明市場有能力吸收單一機構倒閉所帶來的衝擊，而未引發更大規模的市場動盪。
他也並未將目前的高槓桿形容為系統性風險，並指出市場過去通常都能消化個別機構的失敗。「我不會說這已經高到屬於系統性風險，或一定會引發災難，但它確實很高。」
戴蒙強調，目前的市場環境與 2008 年金融危機有所不同，他認為，單靠高槓桿本身並不一定會引發系統性壓力。
他表示，「真正糟糕的是市場出現實質損失。當年問題並不是槓桿，而是房貸資產將實現的龐大損失。」
戴蒙也指出，銀行將持續依市場情況調整抵押品要求。「當市場波動加劇時，結算機構與銀行通常都會要求更多抵押品，所以你很可能會看到這種情況發生。」
此外，戴蒙也警告，資本需求的結構性增加，可能再次推升通膨壓力。他指出，政府財政赤字、基礎建設投資以及全球重新擴軍，都將支撐長期利率維持在較高水準。
戴蒙重申他今年稍早的看法，若這些因素促使投資人尋求持有長天期債券更高的風險補償，這些趨勢「可能成為這場派對上的臭鼬」，也就是掃興、打亂市場樂觀氣氛的因素。
paras_en: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warned that overall financial‑market leverage remains elevated and investors should watch for hidden borrowing that could amplify shocks during market turbulence.

In an interview with CNBC he said, “Margin debt is at a historic high. There’s also a lot of financing you don’t see because it isn’t called margin debt—it shows up under other names. Some of that leverage is public, some is hidden.”
Dimon noted that this leverage comes through major broker‑dealers, hedge funds, ETFs and U.S. Treasury arbitrage trades, adding that “overall market leverage is quite high.”

Recently the market’s focus has returned to financial‑system leverage risk, driven by lofty U.S. equity valuations, hedge‑fund leverage near historic peaks and large‑scale Treasury basis trades, all raising concerns that fragilities in parts of the system may be building up.

Dimon said high leverage means a problem at a single investor or fund could spark broader market volatility. “When that situation exists, it’s more likely that one person can quickly disrupt the market, and market participants will be spooked,” he said.

AI‑focused hedge fund Situational Awareness recently suffered a big loss after a high‑leverage bet on tech stocks went sour, triggering margin calls that forced it to sell most of its listed‑stock portfolio.

When asked about the episode, Dimon, whose firm JPMorgan is one of Situational Awareness’s prime brokers, said the incident actually shows the market can absorb the shock of a single institution’s collapse without sparking a wider turmoil.

He stopped short of labeling today’s high leverage as a systemic risk, noting that markets have usually been able to digest individual failures. “I wouldn’t say it’s high enough to be systemic risk or to guarantee a disaster, but it is indeed very high,” he said.
Dimon stressed that today’s environment differs from the 2008 crisis and that high leverage alone does not necessarily create systemic pressure.
He added, “The real problem is when the market incurs real losses. Back then the issue wasn’t leverage; it was the massive losses that would be realized on mortgage assets.”

Dimon also said banks will keep adjusting collateral requirements as market conditions evolve. “When volatility spikes, clearing houses and banks usually demand more collateral, so you’ll likely see that happen,” he explained.

He warned that a structural rise in capital needs could reignite inflation pressure, pointing to government deficits, infrastructure spending and a global re‑armament drive that will keep long‑term rates elevated.

Dimon reiterated his earlier view that if these factors push investors to demand higher risk premiums for long‑dated bonds, those trends “could be the skunk at this party,” i.e., a factor that spoils the upbeat market mood.

items.title: 貝佐斯今年來首次減持亞馬遜股票 套現3.5億美元
items.title_en: Bezos Sells Amazon Stock for First Time This Year, Cashes Out $350 Million
paras: 美國電商巨擘亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 股價周一（3 日）創紀錄新高之際，創辦人貝佐斯出售價值近 3.5 億美元的亞馬遜股票，這是他今年來首次出售亞馬遜股份。
據《彭博》周四報導，美股周三盤後發布的 Form 4 申報文件中披露了這筆交易。這位億萬富豪兩天前在另一份文件中表示，計畫出售最多 1,500 萬股亞馬遜股票，價值超過 40 億美元，此次出售僅占該計畫一小部分。
今年來亞馬遜股價勁漲 18%，貝佐斯的財富增加了 387 億美元，達到 2,920 億美元。亞馬遜上周公布雲端運算業務營收表現強勁後，成為全球第五家市值突破 3 兆美元的公司。
貝佐斯此次售股後，仍以 8.16% 的持股比例遙遙領先，是亞馬遜最大股東。
貝佐斯近年來加快出售亞馬遜股票。自 2020 年以來，他便出售了價值超過 380 億美元的股份。相比之下，從亞馬遜 1997 年首次公開募股到 2020 年之前，他累計出售的股票不到 100 億美元。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: U.S. e‑commerce giant Amazon (AMZN‑US) saw its share price hit a record high on Monday (the 3rd), and founder Jeff Bezos sold Amazon stock worth nearly $350 million, marking his first sale of Amazon shares this year.

According to Bloomberg on Thursday, a Form 4 filing released after market close on Wednesday disclosed the transaction. The billionaire had indicated two days earlier in another filing that he planned to sell up to 15 million Amazon shares, valued at over $4 billion, and this sale represents only a small portion of that plan.

Amazon’s stock has surged 18% so far this year, boosting Bezos’s wealth by $38.7 billion to $292 billion. After Amazon reported strong cloud‑computing revenue last week, it became the world’s fifth company with a market value exceeding $3 trillion.
After this sale, Bezos still holds an 8.16% stake, remaining far ahead as Amazon’s largest shareholder.

Bezos has accelerated his Amazon stock sales in recent years. Since 2020 he has sold shares worth more than $38 billion. By contrast, from Amazon’s IPO in 1997 up to 2020 he sold less than $10 billion worth of stock.
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication.)

items.title: 伊朗總統：目前很難與最高領袖穆吉塔巴聯繫
items.title_en: Iran President: Currently Difficult to Contact Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei
paras: 伊朗總統裴澤斯基安 (Masoud Pezeshkian) 週三 (6 日) 表示，目前與最高領袖穆吉塔巴 · 哈米尼 (Mojtaba Khamenei) 保持聯繫「非常困難」，但強調對方依然是伊朗的重要精神支柱，在國家面臨外部壓力之際具有關鍵凝聚作用。
裴澤斯基安是在就職兩週年接受伊朗國營電視台專訪時作出上述表示。裴澤斯基安表示：「目前要與他 (穆吉塔巴) 聯繫非常困難，但無論如何，他的存在對我們而言都是極大的精神支柱，讓我們得以繼續前進。」
他指出，政府官員越能坦率向最高領袖說明問題，彼此就越容易建立共識並形成一致決策。
談及穆吉塔巴時，裴澤斯基安形容他是一位「非凡的人物」，並表示自己對其品格、謙遜態度及理性判斷留下深刻印象。
針對近期國內輿論，裴澤斯基安批評，有人藉由最高領袖對美伊合作備忘錄的立場刻意製造內部分裂。他指出，穆吉塔巴最終公開支持這項協議，儘管一開始曾抱持保留態度。
這份共 14 點的美伊合作備忘錄於 2026 年 6 月 17 日，由美國總統川普 (Donald Trump) 與裴澤斯基安簽署，內容包括正式停火、解除海上封鎖及停止雙方軍事行動，目的在為後續和平談判建立框架。
裴澤斯基安表示，伊朗目前正承受來自外部日益升高的壓力，包括制裁與軍事對抗，對手試圖藉此激化民眾不滿情緒，甚至鼓動示威抗議。他形容，這是自 1979 年伊斯蘭革命以來，伊朗面臨最艱難的時期。
穆吉塔巴於今年 3 月 8 日接任伊朗最高領袖，其父親、前最高領袖阿里 · 哈米尼 (Ali Khamenei) 於 2 月 28 日在德黑蘭遭美國與以色列聯合空襲身亡。
伊朗領導層交接期間，美伊軍事衝突持續升溫。伊朗曾以飛彈及無人機攻擊駐有美軍基地的波灣國家作為報復，雙方隨後於 4 月達成停火，並在巴基斯坦斡旋下於 6 月簽署合作備忘錄，盼為終結衝突與推動長期和平奠定基礎。
不過，這項協議於上月破裂，美伊再度爆發近兩週的軍事衝突，直到傳出雙方重新展開談判後，川普才下令停止空襲，使戰事暫時降溫。
paras_en: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated on Wednesday (6th) that it is currently 'very difficult' to maintain contact with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, but emphasized that he remains an important spiritual pillar for Iran, playing a crucial role in uniting the nation in the face of external pressure.

Pezeshkian made the statement during an interview with Iran's state-run television on the occasion of his two-year presidency. He said, 'It is very difficult to contact him (Mojtaba) now, but regardless, his presence is a huge spiritual pillar for us, allowing us to continue moving forward.'
He pointed out that government officials are more likely to establish consensus and make unified decisions when they are honest with the Supreme Leader about the problems they face.
When discussing Mojtaba, Pezeshkian described him as an 'extraordinary person' and expressed his deep impression of Mojtaba's character, humility, and rational judgment.

In response to recent domestic opinion, Pezeshkian criticized some people for intentionally creating internal divisions by taking advantage of the Supreme Leader's stance on the US-Iran cooperation memorandum. He noted that Mojtaba ultimately publicly supported the agreement, despite initially having reservations.

The 14-point US-Iran cooperation memorandum, signed on June 17, 2026, by US President Donald Trump and Pezeshkian, includes formal ceasefire, lifting of naval blockade, and cessation of military actions, with the aim of establishing a framework for future peace talks.

Pezeshkian stated that Iran is currently facing increasing external pressure, including sanctions and military confrontation, with opponents trying to fuel public discontent and even incite protests. He described this as the most difficult period Iran has faced since the 1979 Islamic Revolution.

Mojtaba took over as Iran's Supreme Leader on March 8 this year, following the death of his father, former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, who was killed in a joint US-Israeli airstrike in Tehran on February 28.

During the transition of power in Iran, the military conflict between the US and Iran escalated. Iran had retaliated by launching missiles and drones at US military bases in Gulf countries, followed by a ceasefire in April and the signing of the cooperation memorandum in June, facilitated by Pakistan, in the hope of establishing a foundation for ending the conflict and promoting long-term peace.

However, the agreement broke down last month, leading to a near two-week military conflict between the US and Iran, which only subsided after Trump ordered a halt to airstrikes following reports of renewed negotiations.

items.title: Yardeni：AI交易進入成果導向時代 市場不再為題材埋單
items.title_en: Yardeni: AI Trading Enters Outcome-Oriented Era, Market No Longer Blindly Buys Hyperscalers
paras: Yardeni Research 最新報告指出，投資人已不再像 AI 浪潮初期一樣，對大型雲端服務商 (Hyperscalers) 的 AI 布局照單全收，而是開始依據各家公司實際的資本支出、已簽約訂單及雲端業務成長表現，重新評估投資價值。
AI 投資熱潮正在進入新階段，最新報告指出，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US) 與甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 四大雲端業者 2026 會計年度合計資本支出預計約達 6,000 億美元，較 2025 會計年度的 3,090 億美元大幅增加。
受到電力供應、設備交付及地方政府許可等因素影響，不少資料中心建設時程已延後至 2027 年甚至更晚，但 Yardeni 認為，這代表的是建設時程遞延，而非企業縮減 AI 投資。
Yardeni 引用研究機構 Sightline Climate 的統計指出，目前追蹤的 777 個大型資料中心計畫中，真正取消的僅有 9 個，顯示 AI 基礎建設投資仍持續推進，整體需求並未出現明顯退潮。
除了持續擴大資本支出之外，四大雲端業者手中也握有龐大的未履約合約 (RPO)。
截至 2026 會計年度，四家公司合計未履約合約規模已超過 2.3 兆美元，其中微軟約 6,780 億美元居冠，甲骨文則約 6,380 億美元，代表未來仍有大量已簽約、尚未認列的收入可望逐步實現。
不過，Yardeni 也提醒，市場仍須留意客戶集中風險，尤其 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 是否能如期履行龐大的算力採購承諾。
標普全球評級 (S&P Global Ratings) 今年 7 月便以甲骨文對 OpenAI 依賴程度較高為由，將其信用評等調降至 BBB-，反映市場對相關風險的擔憂。
報告也指出，AI 基礎建設的資金來源正出現變化。
過去大型雲端業者多仰賴自身營運現金流支應資本支出，但隨著投資規模快速擴大，自由現金流已不足以完全支撐。
Alphabet 於 2026 年第二季首次出現單季自由現金流轉負，亞馬遜截至 6 月底的近 12 個月自由現金流亦轉為流出 76 億美元。
根據高盛估算，2025 年大型雲端業者約有 26% 的資本支出透過外部融資 (主要為舉債) 支應，預估 2026 年將升至 33%，2027 年則可能進一步提高至約 35%，顯示 AI 投資更加地依賴外部資金。
儘管投入成本持續增加，各家雲端業務仍維持強勁成長。微軟 Cloud 2026 會計年度營收達 2,143 億美元，年增 27%；AWS 截至 6 月底近四季累計營收 1,347 億美元，年增 50%；Google Cloud 營收 777 億美元，年增 60%；Oracle Cloud 營收 340 億美元，年增 39%。
Yardeni 表示，市場如今已不再將大型雲端業者視為同一投資族群，而是根據各家公司 AI 投資策略、未履約訂單規模及實際雲端營收表現逐一評價。
以今年股價表現來看，甲骨文因自由現金流惡化及對 OpenAI 高度依賴的疑慮，今年以來股價仍下跌 28%；微軟則在雲端業績優於預期後收復部分跌幅；Alphabet 今年累計上漲 20%，亞馬遜在 AWS 財報帶動下，今年以來亦上漲約 18%。
Yardeni 總結指出，AI 投資主軸已經發生根本轉變，市場不再僅憑對 AI 前景的期待給予高估值，而是更加重視企業是否真正展現出營收成長、訂單能見度以及資本投入所帶來的實際成果。
paras_en: Yardeni Research's latest report indicates that investors are no longer blindly following the AI wave, as they did in its early stages, and are instead reassessing investment values based on actual capital expenditures, signed contracts, and cloud business growth.

The AI investment frenzy is entering a new phase, with the report indicating that Amazon (AMZN-US), Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), and Oracle (ORCL-US) will collectively spend around $600 billion on capital expenditures in 2026, a significant increase from $309 billion in 2025.

Despite delays in data center construction due to factors such as power supply, equipment delivery, and local government permits, Yardeni believes this represents a delay in construction schedules rather than a reduction in AI investment.

According to Sightline Climate, a research institution, only 9 out of 777 large data center projects have been canceled, indicating that AI infrastructure investment continues to push forward, with no significant decline in demand.
In addition to increasing capital expenditures, the four major cloud providers also have massive unpaid contracts (RPOs) in hand.

As of 2026, the total value of unpaid contracts for the four companies exceeds $2.3 trillion, with Microsoft leading the pack at around $678 billion, followed by Oracle at around $638 billion, indicating a large amount of future revenue that will be gradually realized.

However, Yardeni also warns that market participants should be cautious of customer concentration risks, particularly with OpenAI and Anthropic's ability to fulfill their massive computing power procurement commitments.
In July, S&P Global Ratings downgraded Oracle's credit rating to BBB- due to its high dependence on OpenAI, reflecting market concerns about related risks.
The report also notes that the funding sources for AI infrastructure are changing.

In the past, large cloud providers relied heavily on their own operating cash flows to fund capital expenditures, but as investment scales rapidly, free cash flow is no longer sufficient to fully support it.
Alphabet reported a negative free cash flow in the second quarter of 2026, and Amazon's free cash flow turned negative in the 12 months ending June 30, totaling $76 billion.

According to Goldman Sachs estimates, in 2025, large cloud providers relied on external financing (mainly debt) for around 26% of their capital expenditures, which is expected to rise to 33% in 2026 and potentially reach around 35% in 2027, indicating that AI investment is becoming increasingly dependent on external funding.

Despite increasing costs, cloud businesses continue to maintain strong growth. Microsoft Cloud's revenue reached $214 billion in 2026, a 27% increase year-over-year; AWS reported $134.7 billion in revenue over the past four quarters, a 50% increase year-over-year; Google Cloud's revenue reached $77.7 billion, a 60% increase year-over-year; and Oracle Cloud's revenue reached $34 billion, a 39% increase year-over-year.

Yardeni notes that the market is no longer viewing large cloud providers as a single investment group, but rather evaluating each company based on its AI investment strategy, unpaid contract size, and actual cloud revenue performance.

Looking at this year's stock performance, Oracle's stock has fallen 28% due to concerns about its free cash flow and high dependence on OpenAI, while Microsoft has recovered some of its losses after its cloud business exceeded expectations; Alphabet's stock has risen 20% this year, and Amazon's stock has risen around 18% this year, driven by AWS's strong earnings.

Yardeni concludes that the main axis of AI investment has undergone a fundamental shift, with the market no longer relying solely on expectations of AI's future prospects to assign high valuations, but rather focusing on whether companies are actually demonstrating revenue growth, order visibility, and the actual results of capital investment.

items.title: 輝達急尋中國AI基地台供應商 明後年啟動端側算力組網
items.title_en: Nvidia Urgently Seeking Chinese AI Base Station Supplier, Plans Edge Computing Network Launch in Next One to Two Years
paras: 美國晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 正在中國急尋 AI 基地台供應商，開發 6G AI-RAN 基地台（既負責通訊連接，又能承擔 AI 運算的基地台）。
通訊產業鏈核心人士透露，輝達正在加速進入電信市場，並在中國尋找基地台廠商合作方，開發符合海外市場要求的 6G 基地台。
據《界面新聞》6 日（周四）報導，該人士形容，輝達在找端側算力的「下一個中際旭創」，因為輝達認為，算力接下來要從資料中心傳輸到海量的 AI 終端和用戶，最終需要依賴基地台的無線傳輸。
上述人士稱，輝達推動這一項目的節奏「比較緊迫」，希望在 2027 或 2028 年進入試驗網。
據《界面新聞》報導，深圳佳賢通信是輝達正在建立的基地台合作方之一，其內部人士證實，輝達從 2025 年就與公司接觸，雙方正基於輝達 CUDA 生態合作開發 6G AI-RAN 基地台，雙方合作已持續半年多。
「佳賢通信和輝達已經組建了專門工作組。輝達方面有十餘人參與其中，成員分布在新加坡、香港及中國內地。目前工作組正圍繞輝達 CUDA 系統的開源生態進行研究。」佳賢通信相關人士說。
佳賢通信成立於 2011 年，總部位於深圳，是一家 AI-RAN 無線通訊產品及解決方案提供商。
據《界面新聞》報導，佳賢通信與輝達的合作進入技術研發階段，不排除成立商業主體，聯合進行海外拓展。
「首先在技術層面，我們已經開始合作。」佳賢通信相關人士表示，目前在雙方的合作中，輝達並不直接生產和銷售完整基地台，而是以晶片和技術生態的方式參與，即基地台公司採購輝達 GPU，並基於輝達 CUDA 生態開發 6G AI-RAN 基地台，完成產品後，再向海外市場銷售。
「預計今年年底跟輝達開發的 AI 基地台樣機就會出來，在驗證通過後，一兩年內就會推向市場。」上述人士說。
對輝達來說，AI 基地台是一門不亞於算力資料中心的好生意。
AI 1.0 階段，算力主要集中在資料中心，輝達銷售大量 GPU；AI 應用落地 2.0 階段，端側算力應用空間更為廣闊，輝達希望邊緣和端側算力也採用其晶片，因此布局 AI 基地台，是輝達為即將到來的端側算力做準備。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US), the U.S. chip giant, is urgently looking for AI base station suppliers in China to develop 6G AI‑RAN base stations that handle both communications connectivity and AI computing.

Industry insiders in the telecom supply chain say Nvidia is accelerating its entry into the telecom market and is seeking Chinese base‑station partners to develop 6G stations that meet overseas market requirements.

According to a report by Jiemian News on Thursday the 6th, the source described Nvidia as searching for the “next Zhongji Xuchuang” for edge computing, because Nvidia believes future compute will shift from data centers to massive AI endpoints and users, ultimately relying on wireless transmission via base stations.
The source said Nvidia’s pace for this project is “quite urgent,” hoping to enter a trial network in 2027 or 2028.

Jiemian News reported that Shenzhen Jiashen Communications is one of the base‑station partners Nvidia is establishing; an insider confirmed Nvidia has been in contact with the company since 2025 and the two have been co‑developing a 6G AI‑RAN base station based on Nvidia’s CUDA ecosystem for over half a year.

“Jiashen Communications and Nvidia have formed a dedicated working group. More than ten Nvidia staff are involved, located in Singapore, Hong Kong and mainland China. The group is currently researching around Nvidia’s open‑source CUDA ecosystem,” said a Jiashen Communications representative.
Jiashen Communications was founded in 2011, is headquartered in Shenzhen, and provides AI‑RAN wireless communication products and solutions.
Jiemian News said the cooperation between Jiashen Communications and Nvidia has entered the technical R&D stage, and a commercial entity may be formed to jointly pursue overseas expansion.

“On the technical side, we have already started cooperating,” said the Jiashen representative. Currently Nvidia does not directly manufacture or sell complete base stations; instead it participates through chips and its technology ecosystem, with the base‑station maker purchasing Nvidia GPUs and developing 6G AI‑RAN stations on the CUDA platform, then selling the finished products overseas.
“We expect a prototype AI base station developed with Nvidia to be ready by the end of this year; after validation, it should reach the market within one to two years,” the source added.
For Nvidia, AI base stations represent a business as significant as data‑center compute.

In the AI 1.0 era, compute was concentrated in data centers and Nvidia sold large volumes of GPUs; in the AI 2.0 era, edge and endpoint compute opportunities are far broader, and Nvidia wants its chips to be used there as well, so its push into AI base stations is preparation for the upcoming wave of edge computing.

items.title: 記憶體股血流成河 馬斯克一句話救信心：供不應求才剛開始
items.title_en: Memory Stocks Flooded with Blood, Musk’s One Sentence Restores Confidence: Supply Shortage Is Just Beginning
paras: 美國兩大記憶體廠商 SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 與威騰電子 (WDC-US) 雖公布亮眼財報，但業績展望未達市場高期待，引發投資人失望，兩家公司股價週三（5 日）美股盤後雙雙重挫。記憶體股賣壓隨後蔓延至亞洲，南韓「記憶體雙雄」SK 海力士 (000660KS) 與三星電子 (005930KS) 週四分別下跌 10.3% 及 6.3%，日本快閃記憶體大廠鎧俠股價也暴跌逾 10%，市場憂慮 AI 帶動的記憶體行情面臨獲利預期修正壓力。
然而，在 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克看來，投資者完全不應為記憶體的需求感到擔憂，因為在 AI 熱潮中，最大的瓶頸之一正是記憶體。他明確表示，記憶體晶片的需求增長速度遠遠超過了供應增速。
馬斯克對記憶體晶片的需求狀況具備很強的發言權，因為特斯拉和 SpaceX 均是記憶體晶片的重要買家。特斯拉和 SpaceX 的未來發展都高度依賴於人工智能，並且都在大舉斥資採購 AI 晶片、記憶體晶片以及其它用於數據中心的 AI 基礎設施，這意味著馬斯克擁有洞察記憶體需求的絕佳視角。
SpaceX 週三公佈了 IPO 後的首份業績，隨後的電話會議展示了關於火箭、機器人、星艦和衛星的宏大計劃。然而，對於緊盯半導體股票、每日跟隨晶片股行情變動的市場而言，真正抓住人們眼球的是馬斯克關於記憶體晶片的深刻言論。
「目前的限制因素是記憶體，」馬斯克直言，「記憶體產量每年增長約 20%。通常來說，這對任何龐大且成熟的行業而言，這一速度已經非常驚人。但請想一想：需求每年增長 20% 嗎？不，需求每年增長 200% 甚至更多。所以，當需求的增長速度遠超供給時，基礎經濟學原理告訴我們，價格應該上漲，而不是下跌。」
馬斯克的這一觀點，與一些分析師近期提出的理論形成了鮮明對比。
此前，部分分析師認為 SK 海力士等公司的產能擴張，可能會導致記憶體晶片供過於求並壓低價格。整個夏季，市場都在激烈爭論半導體超級週期能否延續，投資者對 AI 資本開支熱潮能持續多久充滿疑慮。
在 7 月遭受重創後，進入 8 月晶片類股行情雖有所回暖，但當前圍繞晶片類股的市場情緒仍然十分脆弱。由於 Sandisk 和威騰電子的業績，未能滿足投資者的超高期待，週四亞洲市場上的記憶體族群才出現了大幅下跌。
儘管 SanDisk 與威騰電子的營收和利潤均超出市場預期，但 Sandisk 的業績指引略微不及市場預期，而威騰電子的指引也未能帶來任何驚喜，相較於希捷科技上週給出的業績指引要遜色得多。
高盛指出，過高的市場預期令兩家公司的股價難以從亮眼業績中獲益，導致業績公佈後兩檔股票雙雙承壓下跌。馬斯克此次的公開表態，或許能為動盪不安的記憶體晶片市場注入一劑強心針。
paras_en: U.S. memory giants SanDisk (SNDKV-US) and Western Digital (WDC-US) posted impressive earnings, but their outlook fell short of lofty market expectations, disappointing investors and sending both stocks sharply lower after Wednesday’s (the 5th) U.S. market close. The sell‑off in memory stocks then spread to Asia, where South Korea’s “memory twins” SK Hynix (000660KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930KS) fell 10.3% and 6.3% respectively on Thursday, and Japanese flash‑memory leader Kioxia saw its shares plunge more than 10%, as the market worries that AI‑driven memory demand is now facing profit‑margin revisions.

However, SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk argues investors should not worry about memory demand at all, because one of the biggest bottlenecks in the AI boom is precisely memory. He stated clearly that the growth rate of demand for memory chips far outpaces the growth rate of supply.

Musk’s view on memory‑chip demand carries weight because both Tesla and SpaceX are major buyers of memory chips. Their future development is heavily dependent on artificial intelligence, and they are pouring money into AI chips, memory chips and other AI‑infrastructure for data centers, giving Musk an excellent perspective on memory demand.

SpaceX released its first post‑IPO earnings on Wednesday, and the subsequent earnings call highlighted ambitious plans for rockets, robots, Starship and satellites. Yet for a market that watches semiconductor stocks and chip‑stock movements daily, the real headline‑grabber was Musk’s pointed comments on memory chips.

“The current constraint is memory,” Musk said bluntly. “Memory production is growing about 20% a year. For any large, mature industry that’s already a remarkable rate. But think about this: does demand grow 20% a year? No – demand is growing 200% or more each year. So when demand outpaces supply that dramatically, basic economics tells us prices should rise, not fall.”
Musk’s viewpoint stands in stark contrast to theories recently put forward by some analysts.

Earlier, several analysts warned that capacity expansions by companies such as SK Hynix could lead to oversupply of memory chips and push prices down. Throughout the summer, the market has fiercely debated whether the semiconductor super‑cycle can continue, and investors remain skeptical about how long the AI‑capex frenzy will last.

After a heavy hit in July, the chip sector showed some recovery in August, but sentiment around chip stocks remains fragile. Because SanDisk’s and Western Digital’s results failed to meet investors’ sky‑high expectations, the memory segment in Asian markets slumped sharply on Thursday.

Although both SanDisk and Western Digital posted revenue and profit above market forecasts, SanDisk’s guidance fell slightly short of expectations and Western Digital’s outlook offered no surprises, lagging far behind the guidance Seagate gave last week.

Goldman Sachs noted that overly lofty market expectations made it hard for the two companies’ shares to benefit from their strong results, causing both stocks to slide after the announcements. Musk’s public remarks may provide a much‑needed boost to the turbulent memory‑chip market.

items.title: SK海力士在Nextrade盤前交易驚現30%「閃崩」其交易機制引發市場質疑
items.title_en: SK Hynix Experiences 30% Flash Crash in Pre‑Market Trading on Nextrade, Raising Market Concerns
paras: 南韓半導體巨頭 SK 海力士周四 (6 日) 在南韓另類交易系統 (ATS)Nextrade 的盤前交易中，再次遭遇短暫的「閃崩」事件，這已是一周內發生的第二次異常波動，引發市場對於新型交易所交易穩定性的高度關注。
根據 Nextrade 交易數據，當地時間周四上午 8 點盤前交易開市時，SK 海力士共有 11 股以每股 1,168,000 韓元的價格成交，瞬間觸及 30% 的單日跌停限制。儘管跌勢驚人，但隨後在為時 50 分鐘的交易時段中，股價迅速收復失地，最終盤前僅小跌約 2%。
相較之下，受華爾街科技股走弱影響，SK 海力士在南韓交易所 (KRX) 周四早盤表現雖然疲軟，跌幅一度達 9.8%，但並未出現如 Nextrade 般的極端劇烈震盪。
這類「閃崩」現象不僅侷限於傳統股市，其產生的異常價格也會波及追蹤該股的海外衍生性商品。上周二發生的類似事件，曾導致掛鉤 SK 海力士的加密貨幣衍生品合約，在兩分鐘內觸發了近 6,000 萬美元的多單平倉。
不過，周四這次事件對加密市場的衝擊較小，在 Hyperliquid 區塊鏈平台上的強制清算金額僅約 23 萬美元，分析師認為這是因為先前的波動，已提前清理了市場上的大部分槓桿。
Nextrade 自去年推出以來，憑藉更長的交易時間與更低廉的手續費迅速擴大市場份額。然而，由於這一交易所與主流平台不同，在盤前時段採用連續競價 ，而非集合競價，且僅依賴單一定價來源，被認為削弱了「價格發現」的功能，容易在流動性不足時產生異常成交價。
針對市場質疑，Nextrade 表示另類交易所更強調「交易執行」。為了防止此類事件重演，Nextrade 計畫於 9 月 14 日引進「靜態波動中斷機制」(Static Volatility Interruption)。屆時若報價與前一收盤價偏差超過 10%，將啟動兩分鐘的拍賣程序，以選出能執行最多交易的合理價格。
專家警告，在機制完善前，投資者應留意此類市場結構性風險，避免因異常成交價導致不必要的投資損失。
paras_en: South Korean semiconductor giant SK Hynix on Thursday (the 6th) suffered another brief “flash crash” during pre‑market trading on the country’s alternative trading system (ATS) Nextrade, marking the second abnormal swing within a week and sparking heightened scrutiny of the new venue’s trading stability.

According to Nextrade data, when pre‑market trading opened at 8 a.m. local time on Thursday, SK Hynix recorded 11 shares trading at 1,168,000 won per share, instantly hitting the 30% daily limit‑down. Although the plunge was dramatic, the price recovered quickly during the 50‑minute session, ending the pre‑market session down only about 2%.

In contrast, affected by weaker Wall Street tech stocks, SK Hynix’s early session on the Korea Exchange (KRX) was sluggish, slipping as much as 9.8% but without the extreme volatility seen on Nextrade.

Such flash‑crash episodes are not confined to traditional equity markets; the anomalous pricing can spill over to overseas derivative products that track the stock. A similar incident last Tuesday triggered nearly $60 million of long‑position liquidations in crypto‑linked SK Hynix derivative contracts within two minutes.

However, Thursday’s event had a much smaller impact on the crypto market, with forced liquidations on the Hyperliquid blockchain platform amounting to only about $230,000, which analysts attribute to prior volatility that had already cleared most leveraged exposure.

Since its launch last year, Nextrade has rapidly gained market share thanks to longer trading hours and lower fees. Yet, because the venue differs from mainstream platforms—using continuous auction in the pre‑market instead of a call auction and relying on a single pricing source—it is said to weaken price‑discovery and can produce abnormal trade prices when liquidity is thin.

Addressing market concerns, Nextrade said alternative exchanges place greater emphasis on “trade execution.” To prevent a repeat, Nextrade plans to introduce a “Static Volatility Interruption” mechanism on September 14; if quotes deviate more than 10% from the previous close, a two‑minute auction will be triggered to select a reasonable price that can accommodate the most trades.
Experts warn that until the mechanism is refined, investors should be mindful of this structural market risk and avoid unnecessary losses caused by abnormal trade prices.

items.title: Situational Awareness基金斷臂求生後 已花4億美元重返投資市場
items.title_en: Situational Awareness Fund Re-enters Investment Market After Near Collapse
paras: 前 OpenAI 研究員、現年 25 歲的華爾街新晉投資者 Leopold Aschenbrenner，其執掌的避險基金 Situational Awareness 在經歷了瀕臨崩潰僅僅幾天之後，已經重返投資市場，對一家非上市公司押注 4 億美元。

在 7 月初，Situational Awareness 的資產規模曾高達 450 億美元，但隨著其持有的上市科技股價值迅速縮水，引發了華爾街貸款機構大規模追繳保證金。為了應對資金壓力，Aschenbrenner 一度考慮出售其引以為傲的私募股權，如 Anthropic、Fluidstack 與 MatX 等公司的股份。最終，他與 Ken Griffin 旗下的 Citadel 達成協議，出售了大部分的上市股票組合，以償還貸款並保住私募股權持倉。
這也讓他付出了極大的代價，截至上周四，這支基金的資產規模已暴跌至約 100 億美元，早先槓桿押注賺取的巨額收益，在保證金追繳令的追殺下已付之一炬。
儘管基金元氣大傷，但 Aschenbrenner 隨即展現了重返市場的決心。據知情人士透露，基金已於本周二向一家非上市公司投資 4 億美元，這是繼上個月投入 1 億美元後的追加投資。雖然目前尚不清楚這筆資金具體流向投資組合中的哪家公司，但此舉被視為他試圖透過長期價值投資來重建基金的初步信號。
Situational Awareness 的投資者結構特殊，大多為舊金山灣區的富裕人士與家族辦公室，包括 D1 Capital 創辦人 Dan Sundheim 等知名大咖。儘管經歷劇震，目前尚未出現大規模撤資跡象。
Aschenbrenner 在致投資者的信中承諾，他幾乎所有的個人資產都投入了這支基金，並將從此次經驗中吸取教訓，成為更強大的投資人。
值得一提的是，在基金動盪最劇烈的那個周六，Aschenbrenner 於加州卡梅爾谷完成婚禮，其妻子現任 Anthropic 執行長的幕僚長。這場被譽為「AI 皇室婚禮」的慶典與基金的生存保衛戰同時上演，戲劇性十足。目前他已取消蜜月，親自與每位擔憂的投資者進行電話溝通以安撫情緒。
paras_en: Leopold Aschenbrenner, a 25-year-old former OpenAI researcher and new investor on Wall Street, has led his hedge fund Situational Awareness back into the investment market after a near-collapse, betting $4 billion on a private company.

In early July, Situational Awareness had assets of $45 billion, but the value of its publicly traded tech stocks plummeted, triggering a massive margin call from Wall Street lenders. To address the funding pressure, Aschenbrenner considered selling his prized private equity stakes, including those in Anthropic, Fluidstack, and MatX. Ultimately, he reached an agreement with Ken Griffin's Citadel to sell most of his public stock portfolio to repay loans and preserve his private equity holdings.
This came at a great cost, as the fund's assets had plummeted to around $10 billion by last Thursday, with the huge profits from its earlier leveraged bets wiped out by the margin calls.

Despite the fund's severe losses, Aschenbrenner quickly demonstrated his determination to re-enter the market. According to insiders, the fund invested $4 billion in a private company on Tuesday, following an additional $1 billion investment last month. Although it is unclear which company received the funding, this move is seen as a sign of his attempt to rebuild the fund through long-term value investing.

Situational Awareness has a unique investor structure, primarily consisting of wealthy individuals and family offices from the San Francisco Bay Area, including D1 Capital founder Dan Sundheim. Despite the turmoil, there are no signs of massive withdrawals yet.
In a letter to investors, Aschenbrenner pledged that nearly all of his personal assets are invested in the fund and that he will learn from this experience to become a stronger investor.

Notably, during the most turbulent week for the fund, Aschenbrenner got married in California's Carmel Valley, with his wife serving as the chief of staff to the CEO of Anthropic. This 'AI royal wedding' took place simultaneously with the fund's survival battle, making for a dramatic scene. Aschenbrenner has now canceled his honeymoon and is personally calling concerned investors to reassure them.

items.title: AI狂潮變雙面刃！台韓科技股劇烈震盪 新興市場波動超越新冠疫情
paras: 在人工智慧 (AI) 熱潮下，主導高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 與先進記憶體的南韓、台灣企業大漲，也讓新興市場股市今年成為全球焦點，逐漸擺脫過去追隨美股的角色。
新興市場基金經理人 Carlos von Hardenberg 於 2018 年與新興市場投資老將墨比爾斯 (Mark Mobius) 共同創立 MCP Emerging Markets。他說：「過去投資人只對美國和『科技七巨頭』(Magnificent Seven) 有興趣，因為它們表現實在太好了。但今年情況完全反轉。」
然而，AI 行情也帶來沉重代價。自 6 月底以來，新興市場科技股劇烈震盪，彷彿投資人突然出現「高原反應」。
南韓 KOSPI 指數在三星電子與 SK 海力士帶動下，一度翻倍上漲，但隨後因市場疑慮及監管措施影響，短短六周內回跌約 40%，台積電 (TSM-US) 股價也回落近 14%。
這波修正使南韓市場波動率急升，就連涵蓋 24 個國家、逾 1175 檔股票、市值約 1.8 兆美元的 MSCI 新興市場指數，其波動率也超越新冠疫情高峰。

AI 讓新興市場愈來愈像美股

法國巴黎銀行 (BNP Paribas) 亞太現金股票研究主管 William Bratton 表示，目前許多機構投資人已難以承受南韓市場的劇烈波動。他說：「我們接觸到的機構投資人認為，即使基本面仍相當強勁，目前也不值得冒這麼大的波動風險。」
MSCI 仍將南韓與台灣列為新興市場，主要是因為外資交易兩地貨幣仍存在限制。
但部分市場人士認為，AI 熱潮讓新興市場出現過去夢寐以求的科技股行情，如今卻演變成「小心願望成真」。
目前在 MSCI 新興市場指數中，僅九家公司便占了權重逾 40%，包括台灣、南韓大型科技股，以及中國阿里巴巴 (BABA-US) 與騰訊 (00700-HK) 等企業，集中度甚至高於美股。
MSCI 研究主管 Ashley Lester 說：「過去投資人把新興市場視為分散投資來源，但如今隨著 AI 硬體龍頭崛起，新興市場已不再具有過去那種分散效果。它們如今正處於 AI 熱潮的核心。」

外資撤離亞洲 創十多年最大規模

歐洲最大資產管理公司東方匯理 (Amundi) 基金經理人 Ji Young Park 表示，她在市場震盪前已開始降低部分持股，但修正幅度仍讓基金承受不小壓力。
她透露：「過去一個月，南韓股市觸發熔斷機制約六、七次，可見波動程度之高。」
Ji Young Park 表示，她的投資期限約五年，因此並不偏好如此劇烈波動的市場，「我只希望晚上能睡得著。」
瑞士聯合私人銀行 (UBP) 科技投資組合經理人 Dimitri Kallianiotis 則表示，部分私人銀行客戶確實受到市場震盪影響，但他的建議仍是不要恐慌。
倫敦證券交易所集團 (LSEG) 資料顯示，今年上半年，國際資金撤出亞洲 (不含中國) 股市的速度，至少是 2010 年以來同期最快。摩根大通 (JPM-US) 統計也顯示，南韓及台灣首當其衝，分別流出超過 1000 億美元及 440 億美元資金。
由於市場規定基金不得持有單一個股過高比重，投資人也趁三星電子與 SK 海力士過去一年分別大漲約 500% 及 1100% 後，先行獲利了結。
UBP 的 Kallianiotis 說：「投資人應該接受波動，同時避免追逐市場最熱門的股票。如果在最劇烈修正時完全沒有持股，也很可能錯過之後的反彈。」

items.title: 普丁宣布組建無人作戰系統部 應對烏克蘭無人機攻勢
items.title_en: Putin Announces Formation of Unmanned Combat Systems Department to Counter Ukrainian Drone Assault
paras: 俄羅斯總統普丁 5 日（周三）宣布國防系統人事調整，宣布組建新兵種「無人作戰系統部」，以應對烏克蘭無人機攻勢。
8 月 3 日，俄羅斯黑海沿岸沙灘遭無人機襲擊，近 50 人死傷。8 月 4 日，莫斯科州遭無人機襲擊，15 人死傷。
據俄羅斯媒體 5 日報導，俄羅斯中部斯維爾德洛夫斯克州首府葉卡捷琳堡市郊一村莊 4 日發生汽車爆炸事件，烏拉爾無人機廠總經理受重傷，保鏢被炸身亡。
該廠總經理弗拉基米爾 · 特卡丘克在爆炸中身受重傷，被送往醫院重症監護室。特卡丘克的司機兼保鏢在爆炸中身亡。現場影片顯示，特卡丘克乘坐的奔馳在爆炸中被燒毀。俄羅斯有關部門已立案偵查。
paras_en: Russian President Vladimir Putin on Wednesday, the 5th, announced a defence‑system personnel reshuffle, creating a new branch called the “Unmanned Combat Systems Department” to counter Ukraine’s drone offensive.
On August 3 a drone strike hit a beach along Russia’s Black Sea coast, causing nearly 50 deaths and injuries. On August 4 Moscow region was hit by drones, resulting in 15 casualties.

According to Russian media reports on the 5th, a car bomb exploded on the 4th in a village on the outskirts of Yekaterinburg, the capital of Sverdlovsk Oblast in central Russia; the general manager of the Ural drone factory was seriously injured and his bodyguard was killed by the blast.

The plant’s general manager Vladimir Tekachuk was severely wounded in the explosion and was taken to a hospital intensive‑care unit. Tekachuk’s driver‑bodyguard died in the blast. Footage shows the Mercedes he was riding in was burned in the explosion. Russian authorities have opened a criminal investigation.

items.title: 烏克蘭宣布：過去40天攻擊俄羅斯100多處戰略目標
items.title_en: Ukraine Announces: Over 100 Russian Strategic Targets Hit in Past 40 Days
paras: 烏克蘭國家安全局 4 日（周二）宣布，在過去 40 天裡烏方攻擊了俄羅斯 100 多處戰略目標。
烏克蘭國家安全局稱，打擊目標主要包括俄軍工企業、空軍基地、防空系統、指揮所、艦船、「影子艦隊」油輪、煉油廠和軍事後勤設施，造成俄軍大量軍事裝備和多處軍事基礎設施損毀。
烏克蘭國家安全局說，烏方對薩基、近衛軍村、恩格斯等六座軍用機場及葉夫帕托里亞航空工廠發動了打擊，俄方多處煉油廠、油庫、輸油泵站、石油碼頭等能源設施也遭到打擊。
未來烏方將繼續展開削弱俄羅斯軍事經濟潛力的行動。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基 6 月 25 日在社交媒體發文，稱已批准一項 40 天情報行動，旨在迫使俄方結束戰事。
paras_en: Ukraine’s Security Service announced on Tuesday, the 4th, that Ukrainian forces have struck more than 100 Russian strategic targets over the past 40 days.

The agency said the attacks mainly focused on Russian military-industrial enterprises, air bases, air‑defence systems, command posts, vessels, “shadow fleet” tankers, refineries and military logistics facilities, causing extensive damage to Russian equipment and numerous military installations.

It reported strikes on six military airfields – including Sakky, Guard Village and Engels – as well as the Yevpatoria aircraft factory, and said Russian energy sites such as refineries, fuel depots, oil‑pipeline pumping stations and oil terminals were also hit.
Ukraine said it will continue actions aimed at eroding Russia’s military‑economic potential in the future.
President Volodymyr Zelensky posted on social media on June 25 that he had approved a 40‑day intelligence operation intended to force Russia to end the war.

items.title: 俄羅斯電商平台倉庫多次遭襲 傳統零售商也坐不住了
items.title_en: Russian E-commerce Platform Warehouses Attacked, Traditional Retailers Also Affected
paras: 自 7 月 18 日以來，俄羅斯最大在線零售商野莓（Wildberries）的倉庫已多次遭烏克蘭無人機襲擊。8 月 2 日至 5 日，野莓倉庫連續遭遇襲擊，最新一次襲擊發生在俄羅斯圖拉州。
與此同時，俄羅斯第二大在線零售商 Ozon 也表示，因烏克蘭無人機襲擊警報被迫疏散。
俄羅斯國內物流基礎設施面臨的風險日益增加，迫使俄羅斯傳統零售商也開始重新審視其與供應商的合作。
俄羅斯最大快速消費品零售商之一「紅與白」（Red & White）試圖跟風電商平台，向供應商發送提案，要求免除其在無人機襲擊等不可抗力因素下賠付被毀商品的責任。
但供應商反應消極，「紅與白」在 8 月 3 日撤回提案。
此外，俄羅斯一些零售連鎖企業希望供應商直接將貨物送至這些企業的門市或配送中心。該方案可在零售商物流設施運行中斷的情況下，降低面臨的風險。
專家表示，供應商直接向門市配送，會導致成本，售價上漲。
中國外貿商也未能倖免。「我們每天都在遭受損失，多的時候一天就損失上萬元（人民幣）。」浙江童裝外貿人姚東說，他們在俄羅斯‌野莓多地倉庫有共計價值上百萬元的服裝庫存。
自 7 月 18 日凌晨遭受第一次無人機襲擊以來，過去兩周他們總共被炸七次，損失約 8 萬元。在受損後，姚東迅速啟動降價促銷行動，並調整發貨模式。
paras_en: Since July 18, the warehouse of Wildberries, Russia's largest online retailer, has been attacked by Ukrainian drones multiple times. From August 2 to 5, Wildberries' warehouses were attacked consecutively, with the latest attack occurring in Russia's Tula region.
Meanwhile, Ozon, Russia's second-largest online retailer, has also been forced to evacuate due to drone attack warnings.
The increasing risks faced by Russia's domestic logistics infrastructure have forced traditional retailers to re-examine their cooperation with suppliers.

Red & White, one of Russia's largest fast-moving consumer goods retailers, has attempted to follow the lead of e-commerce platforms by sending proposals to suppliers, requesting exemption from liability for damaged goods due to drone attacks and other force majeure factors.
However, suppliers have reacted negatively, and Red & White withdrew its proposal on August 3.

Additionally, some Russian retail chains hope that suppliers will deliver goods directly to their stores or distribution centers, which can reduce the risks faced when logistics facilities are disrupted.
Experts say that direct delivery to stores will lead to increased costs and higher prices.

Chinese foreign trade merchants have also been affected. 'We suffer losses every day, sometimes up to tens of thousands of yuan per day,' said Yao Dong, a Zhejiang children's wear foreign trade merchant, who has clothing inventory worth hundreds of thousands of yuan in Wildberries' warehouses across Russia.

Since the first drone attack on July 18, they have been bombed seven times in the past two weeks, resulting in losses of approximately 80,000 yuan. After the damage, Yao Dong quickly launched a price reduction promotion and adjusted the shipping mode.

items.title: 上周按兵不動是觀察期！Fed庫克放鷹：通膨若不退準備支持升息
items.title_en: Last Week’s Hold Was an Observation Period! Fed’s Cook Takes a Hawkish Stance: Ready to Support Rate Hikes if Inflation Doesn’t Cool
paras: 美國聯準會 (Fed) 理事庫克 (Lisa Cook) 周三 (6 日) 表示，她認為上周沒有必要升息，但若通膨未能很快降溫，她已準備支持進一步升息。 ，以因應「仍然過高」的物價壓力。
庫克在阿拉斯加安克拉治經濟發展公司 (Anchorage Economic Development Corporation) 舉辦的 2026 年經濟午餐會發表演說，她說道：「如果通膨沒有很快開始降溫，我已準備好在必要時採取升息行動。」
她認為在 Fed 雙重使命中，目前通膨風險高於就業風險。若有必要升息抑制物價，她也會同時評估對整體經濟的影響。
她說：「如果有必要讓通膨回落，我將支持升息，但也有可能最後不需要。」

抗通膨空間正在縮小

庫克表示，由於美國通膨已連續五年高於 Fed 設定的 2% 目標，通膨預期逐漸根深蒂固的風險正持續升高。根據 Fed 偏好的個人消費支出 (PCE) 物價指數，6 月通膨年增率為 3.7%。
庫克警告，通膨可能逐漸反映在企業定價與薪資形成過程中，使 Fed 日後壓低通膨的難度提高。她說：「通膨高於目標的時間愈長，這種情況發生的可能性就愈高。因此，在目前環境下，我們沒有等待更久的餘裕。」

上周支持利率不變的原因

庫克並解釋，她上周支持維持利率不變，主因是目前推升通膨的幾項因素未必會持續。去年開始實施的關稅大多已反映在物價上，由於比較基期墊高，未來對通膨的推升效果可能逐步減弱。
她也提到，中東衝突推升油價，但市場普遍預估油價年底前將回落。此外，目前因人工智慧 (AI) 需求帶動而飆升的相關零組件價格，未來也可望隨供應鏈調整而下降。
她說：「因此，我認為目前適合先按兵不動，觀察這些因素如何演變。」

內部鷹聲起

Fed 上周以九比三決議維持聯邦基金利率目標區間於 3.50-3.75% 不變，但已有三位地區聯準銀行總裁主張立即升息 1 碼，以抑制通膨，分別是哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack)、卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari) 和蘿根(Lorie Logan)。
相較之下，Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 仍未針對未來利率路徑提供明確指引，也未詳細說明其貨幣政策決策邏輯。
卡什卡利周三接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，為抑制通膨，現在應開始循序漸進升息，但並非主張大幅提高利率。
另一方面，堪薩斯城聯準銀行總裁施密德 (Jeff Schmid) 周二晚間表示，目前通膨仍過高，要讓通膨回落仍需更高利率支撐。
施密德說：「考量需求與投資依然強勁，我不認為目前貨幣政策立場具有抑制性。」他今年並非聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 具有投票權的成員。
paras_en: Fed Governor Lisa Cook said on Wednesday (the 6th) that she believes there was no need to raise rates last week, but if inflation does not cool quickly she is prepared to support further hikes to address "still too high" price pressures.

Cook made the remarks at a 2026 economic luncheon hosted by the Anchorage Economic Development Corporation, stating, "If inflation does not start to cool quickly, I am ready to take rate‑hiking action when necessary."
She said that within the Fed’s dual mandate, the inflation risk currently outweighs the employment risk, and if a hike is needed to curb prices she will also assess the impact on the broader economy.
She added, "If it is necessary to bring inflation down, I will support a rate hike, but it may ultimately not be needed."

The anti‑inflationary space is shrinking. Cook noted that U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s 2% target for five consecutive years, and the risk of entrenched inflation expectations is rising. According to the Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, June’s annual inflation rate was 3.7%.

Cook warned that inflation could gradually become embedded in corporate pricing and wage‑setting, making it harder for the Fed to bring it down later. She said, "The longer inflation stays above target, the more likely this scenario becomes. Therefore, we do not have the luxury of waiting any longer in the current environment."

Why she supported keeping rates steady last week. Cook explained that the main factors driving inflation may not persist. Most tariffs imposed since last year have already been reflected in prices, and because the base period was higher, their inflationary impact is likely to fade.

She also mentioned that Middle‑East conflicts have pushed oil prices up, but markets generally expect oil to retreat before year‑end. In addition, the surge in component prices driven by AI demand is expected to ease as supply chains adjust.
She said, "Therefore, I think it is appropriate now to hold steady and observe how these factors evolve."

Internal hawks emerge. The Fed voted 9‑3 last week to keep the federal funds target range at 3.50‑3.75% but three regional bank presidents—Beth Hammack, Neel Kashkari and Lorie Logan—advocated an immediate one‑point hike to curb inflation.
In contrast, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has not provided clear guidance on the future rate path nor detailed the logic behind his monetary‑policy decisions.
Kashkari told CNBC on Wednesday that to curb inflation the Fed should now begin a gradual series of rate hikes, though he does not call for a large jump in rates.
Meanwhile, Jeff Schmid, president of the Kansas City Fed, said on Tuesday night that inflation remains too high and that bringing it down will require higher rates for support.
Schmid said, "Given that demand and investment remain strong, I do not think the current monetary stance is restrictive." He is not a voting member of the Federal Open Market Committee this year.

美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 本周稍早證實，美國已與日本共同進場買入日元，這是 2011 年以來雙方首次聯合干預匯市，也是美國自 1998 年以來首度直接出手支撐日元。
貝森特周二接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，美方之所以協助干預，是因為日元若持續走弱，可能對亞洲金融市場造成衝擊。

Meanwhile the yen’s movement was choppy but still far above the 40‑year low set before last week’s joint US‑Japan intervention in the FX market.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.2% to 99.68, its lowest level since June 16.
The focus in the FX market remains on the yen. The yen edged stronger against the dollar, with the latest USD/JPY quote at 157.69, a slight decline.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed earlier this week that the United States has jointly entered the market with Japan to buy yen, marking the first coordinated intervention since 2011 and the first direct U.S. support for the yen since 1998.
In a CNBC interview on Tuesday, Bessent said the U.S. is helping to intervene because a continuously weakening yen could shock Asian financial markets.
Deutsche Bank strategist Jim Reid said, “Our FX strategy team believes the Bank of Japan must accelerate rate hikes to generate a more durable rebound in the yen.”

Japan’s central bank released minutes from its latest rate‑policy meeting on Wednesday, showing policymakers expect that oil‑price shocks from the Middle‑East conflict could slow Japan’s economic growth while pushing inflation higher.

Reid noted, “The June minutes show several members expect consumer inflation to rise markedly in the second half of this fiscal year, with two of eight members advocating faster rate hikes. The newly released Japanese wage data could also keep pressure on the bank to raise rates.”
Economic data weak, dollar under pressure
U.S. economic data remained a market focus. According to ADP, private sector job additions in July were 44,000, well below the 68,000 forecast and down from June’s 95,000.
The figure continues the cooling trend reflected in the June job‑opening data released on Tuesday and provides a reference point for Friday’s July non‑farm payroll report.
Despite weaker labor‑market numbers this week, the overall employment picture remains resilient, supporting the Fed’s recent shift of policy emphasis back to inflation control.
The Middle‑East conflict has caused oil‑price volatility, disrupting inflation trends and creating divergence among Fed officials on the future direction of monetary policy.

In addition, the Institute for Supply Management reported that July’s services‑sector PMI rose to 54.1 from June’s 54, still slightly below the 54.5 market expectation. The services‑price index, which measures changes in input costs for service firms, climbed further from June and has been above 70 in four of the past five months, indicating persistent cost pressure.
Markets anticipate that a Hormuz Strait agreement is close to being reached
Regarding the Middle‑East situation, several U.S. officials, including President Trump, said a key agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz is nearing completion.
Trump told the media on Tuesday evening, “Things are moving very smoothly. I think we’ll know the result within 48 hours.”

items.title: 表面救日元、背後保美債！貝森特盯上Fed疫情時代工具
paras: 美國財長貝森特正敦促聯準會 (Fed) 擴大一項原本為 2020 年美元荒設立的緊急融資工具，讓日本能以持有的美國公債作為擔保借入更多美元，用於買進日元、阻止匯率持續下跌，同時避免東京為籌措干預資金而大舉拋售美債。
日本政府周一表示，計畫動用 Fed 的「外國及國際貨幣當局附買回機制」(FIMA Repo Facility)，為未來的匯市干預籌集美元。這項安排原本不是為支撐外國貨幣設計，如今卻可能成為日本捍衛日元的重要資金來源，也引發 Fed 是否應協助川普政府執行匯率與外交政策的爭議。

抵押美債換美元 日本無須拋售 1.1 兆美元部位

FIMA 機制是在新冠疫情初期設立。當時美元融資市場陷入緊張，部分未與 Fed 建立貨幣交換管道的外國央行，可能被迫出售美國公債換取美元，進一步加劇美債市場的流動性危機。Fed 因此允許外國貨幣當局以美債作為擔保，透過附買回交易取得美元。
在新的運用方式下，日本可將美債暫時交給 Fed 換取美元，再於外匯市場賣出美元、買進日元，達到支撐匯率的目的，而不必直接處分美債。截至 5 月底，日本持有約 1.1 兆美元美國公債，真正限制其融資能力的並非抵押品不足，而是 FIMA 機制對單一交易對手設定的 600 億美元借款上限。
貝森特周日在社群平台 X 公開表示，Fed 可協助提高這項額度，並鼓勵央行未來數月擴大上限。若額度獲得調高，東京便可迅速把更多美債轉化為可供干預的美元資金，也能向市場傳達日本阻貶工具並不像表面上那樣有限，增加投機客放空日元的成本。
日本財務大臣片山皋月周一證實，東京準備使用 FIMA 機制支應未來干預。此前，美日上周五採取聯合行動，由美國與日本同步買進日元，是 1998 年以來首見。美國總統川普將這項行動形容為兩國友誼的象徵，而日元近期一度跌至 40 年低點。

華府要救的不只日元 更要避免日本拋售美債

華府支持日本穩定日元，背後也牽涉美債市場。各國捍衛本幣時，通常會出售外匯存底並買回本國貨幣，而日本的外匯存底主要由美國公債構成。若東京依循傳統方式長期干預，便可能被迫大量拋售美債。
目前美國 30 年期公債殖利率已升至 2007 年以來最高，市場承接能力備受關注。讓日本透過 FIMA 機制抵押美債取得美元，可以避免干預行動進一步推高美債殖利率，這也是華府希望促成這項安排的重要原因。
貝森特其實也能繞過 Fed，由美國財政部發行國庫券籌集美元，再透過規模約 2,000 億美元的外匯穩定基金 (Exchange Stabilization Fund) 提供資金。不過，這種方式的規模更加透明、資源也明顯有限，威嚇市場的效果不如 Fed 融資工具。
Monetary Policy Analytics 經濟學家 Derek Tang 指出，若貝森特無法取得 Fed 支持，其口頭威嚇市場的可信度就會降低。公開要求擴大 FIMA 額度，一方面可能只是無須付出成本的策略性喊話，讓市場相信日本握有更強火力；另一方面，也可能是在對聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 其他成員施壓。
弱勢日元同時推高日本通膨預期，促使投資人要求更高報酬才願意持有日本公債。日本 10 年期公債殖利率今年以來已上升 0.75 個百分點。由於日本金融機構是全球最大的跨境債權人，國內殖利率走高將降低其持有海外債券的誘因，可能吸引原本投入美債、德國公債及英國公債的資金回流日本。

Fed 要不要配合？華許獨立性迎來首次考驗

調高 FIMA 單一交易對手 600 億美元的借款上限，需要至少部分 FOMC 成員批准。Fed 通常只有在市場運作失靈或金融穩定受到威脅，並可能妨礙貨幣政策傳導時，才會擴大使用這類工具；目前的市場情況似乎尚未達到這項門檻。Fed 發言人拒絕置評。
這項要求也成為華許 5 月接掌 Fed 後，如何劃分央行與川普政府權力界線的首場考驗。Fed 的獨立性通常主要體現在利率決策，因為利率最容易受到政治壓力影響；但涉及向外國央行提供貸款等其他職能時，央行與行政部門之間的界線向來較為模糊。
華許在任命確認前提交給參議員的書面答覆中表示，Fed 在制定利率政策時擁有最高程度的獨立性，但在其他領域則不完全如此。涉及國際金融議題時，Fed 官員並不享有特殊決定權，央行應與政府及國會合作。
不過，華許上月在國會聽證會被問及類似問題時，又把 Fed 與外國央行的常設美元融資管道稱為貨幣政策的一部分。如今尚不清楚，他會把協助日本干預日元歸入央行貨幣政策，還是川普政府的外交及財政政策。貝森特與華許經常聯絡，這項決定也將檢驗新任 Fed 主席能否在配合政府與維護央行自主性之間取得平衡。

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢回流股匯雙漲 強升1.32角收32.315元
items.title_en: Hot Money Flows Back, Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Rise
paras: 美國與伊朗可能很快就重新開放荷姆茲海峽達成協議，國際油價應聲重挫，熱錢進一步回流亞洲，台北股匯今 (5) 日同步走揚，新台幣兌美元一度強升 1.7 角，尾盤升幅收斂，收在 32.315 元，升值 1.32 角，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 28.395 億美元。
中東地緣政治出現緩和跡象，美元轉弱，外資回頭大買台股 903 億元，寫下單日史上第三大買超紀錄，加權指數終場上漲 1250.94 點，收在 44611.6 點。權王台積電收在 2405 元，上漲 85 元。
在熱錢回流下，新台幣兌美元盤中一舉攻克 32.4、32.3 元兩道關卡，一度衝上 32.274 元，強升逾 1.7 角，終場收在 32.315 元，升值 1.32 角。
觀察主要亞幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，韓元升值 0.5% 最強，新台幣亦升 0.41%，星幣升值 0.13%，人民幣升 0.08%，日元小升 0.06%，亞幣普遍走揚。
在美日聯手干預匯市下，日元周一強勢大漲超過 2%，昨日小幅回落後，今天呈現盤整走勢。美國財政部長貝森特周二表示，日元持續疲軟可能破壞整個亞洲市場穩定，甚至引發其他貨幣競爭性貶值，因此，在有利於美國經濟的前提下，川普政府將「不惜一切代價」支持日本穩定匯市。
paras_en: The possibility of the US and Iran reaching an agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz has led to a decline in international oil prices. As a result, hot money has flowed back into Asia, causing the Taiwan stock market and currency to rise simultaneously. The Taiwanese dollar appreciated by 1.32 points to close at 32.315 against the US dollar, with a peak increase of 1.7 points. The total trading value in the Taipei foreign exchange market was $2.8395 billion.

The easing of tensions in the Middle East has led to a weakening of the US dollar, prompting foreign investors to buy Taiwanese stocks heavily, with a net buy of $9.03 billion, the third-highest single-day record. The weighted index rose by 1,250.94 points to close at 44,611.6. TSMC, the semiconductor giant, closed at $2405, up $85.

As hot money flowed back in, the Taiwanese dollar broke through the 32.4 and 32.3 thresholds against the US dollar, peaking at 32.274, with an appreciation of over 1.7 points, before closing at 32.315, up 1.32 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won appreciated the most, rising by 0.5% against the US dollar, followed by the Taiwanese dollar, which rose by 0.41%. The Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan also rose by 0.13% and 0.08%, respectively, while the Japanese yen edged up by 0.06%. Most Asian currencies rose against the US dollar.

Under the joint intervention of the US and Japan in the foreign exchange market, the Japanese yen surged by over 2% on Monday, before slightly retreating on Tuesday. On Wednesday, it presented a consolidating trend. US Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin stated on Tuesday that the continued weakness of the Japanese yen could disrupt the stability of the entire Asian market and even trigger competitive devaluations of other currencies. Therefore, the Trump administration will 'do everything' to support Japan in stabilizing its currency, as long as it is beneficial to the US economy.

items.title: 日本薪資連六月增長 勞動力市場緊俏強化日銀升息預期
items.title_en: Japan's Wages Rise for Sixth Straight Month, Boosting BOJ Rate Hike Expectations
paras: 日本勞動省周三 (5 日) 公佈的最新數據顯示，受惠於強勁的企業獲利與持續緊俏的勞動力市場，日本薪資增長勢頭穩健，進一步強化了市場對日本銀行在未來幾個月再次升息的預期。
數據顯示，日本 6 月名目薪資年增 3.4%，符合經濟學家預期，這也是名目薪資連續第五個月增幅超過 3%，創下 34 年來最長的紀錄。特別是，調整通膨後的實質薪資成長了 1.6% 至 1.7%，不僅連續第六個月上揚，更寫下 2021 年以來最長的連漲紀錄。
其中，6 月的名目薪資的加速，顯示薪資成長的動力已從波動較大的獎金 (一次性支付) 轉向更具持續性的固定薪資。這種結構性轉變正是日本銀行長期觀察的重點，認為這代表通膨正逐漸由需求驅動，而非單純的成本推升。
薪資的強勁表現主要反映了今年「春鬥」薪資談判的豐碩成果。日本最大工會聯合會 (Rengo) 爭取到超過 5% 的加薪，而大型企業如經團連 (Keidanren) 成員的平均加薪幅度更達到 5.4%。此外，超過 70% 的企業表示，加薪的主要動力是為了在緊俏的勞動力市場中招募與留住人才。
日本銀行總裁植田和男在近期的記者會中展現出鷹派立場，警示價格上行的風險正在加劇。
分析師認為，穩健的薪資增長讓日銀更有底氣維持政策正常化路徑，升息時機最快可能落在 9 月，或者不遲於今年 12 月。此外，日本政府近期與美國協調干預匯市以支撐日元，也強化了市場對於政策提前調整的預期。
儘管薪資漲勢亮眼，但食品價格通膨仍維持在高點，讓一般家庭對生活成本感到憂心。為減緩民眾壓力，日本政府計畫從明年 4 月起暫時調降食品銷售稅，並向低收入戶發放補貼。
大和證券 (Daiwa Securities) 經濟學家 Kento Minami 表示，隨著中東局勢升溫導致企業加速轉嫁成本，實質薪資在今年 11 月後仍可能面臨暫時轉負的下行壓力。
paras_en: The Japanese Ministry of Labor released data on Wednesday (5th) showing that Japan's wages have risen for the sixth consecutive month, driven by strong corporate profits and a tight labor market, further strengthening market expectations of a rate hike by the Bank of Japan in the coming months.
The data showed that Japan's nominal wages rose 3.4% in June, in line with economists' expectations, marking the fifth consecutive month of wage growth above 3%, a record 34-year high.

The acceleration in nominal wages in June indicates that wage growth is shifting from volatile bonuses to more sustainable fixed wages, a structural change that the Bank of Japan has been closely watching, as it believes this represents a shift towards demand-driven inflation, rather than simply cost-push inflation.

The strong wage performance mainly reflects the rich harvest of this year's 'spring struggle' wage negotiations. The largest labor union federation (Rengo) secured wage increases of over 5%, while large companies such as Keidanren members achieved an average wage increase of 5.4%. Moreover, over 70% of companies said that wage increases were mainly driven by the need to recruit and retain talent in a tight labor market.
Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda has shown a hawkish stance in recent press conferences, warning of the increasing risk of price increases.

Analysts believe that the stable wage growth has given the BOJ more confidence to maintain its normalization policy path, with the timing of the next rate hike potentially as early as September or not later than December this year. Additionally, the Japanese government's recent coordination with the US to intervene in the foreign exchange market to support the yen has strengthened market expectations of an earlier policy adjustment.

Although wage growth is strong, food price inflation remains high, leaving households concerned about living costs. To alleviate public pressure, the Japanese government plans to temporarily reduce food sales tax from April next year and provide subsidies to low-income households.

Daiwa Securities economist Kento Minami said that with the Middle East situation escalating, leading to companies accelerating cost transfers, real wages may face temporary downward pressure from November this year.

items.title: 印度央行維持利率不變 在通膨壓力與地緣政治迷霧中尋求韌性
items.title_en: India's Central Bank Keeps Rates Unchanged Amid Inflation Pressure and Geopolitical Uncertainty
paras: 印度央行 (RBI) 周三 (5 日) 宣布將基準利率維持在 5.25%，這是央行連續第五次維持利率不變。儘管印度的零售通膨率已突破了 4% 的中期目標，由總裁馬洛特拉 (Sanjay Malhotra) 領導的貨幣政策委員會仍全體一致投票通過維持回購利率，並保持中立的政策立場。
數據顯示，受油價飆升影響，印度 6 月份消費者物價指數 (CPI) 觸及 18 個月高點 4.38%。雖然整體通膨超標，但馬洛特拉強調，核心通膨 (不含食品與能源) 仍維持在 3.7% 的適度水準，且目前尚未看到價格壓力全面擴散的跡象。
央行預計，整體通膨將在第三季達到峰值後回落，並將全年度通膨預測從 5.1% 略微下調至 5.0%。
印度目前仍是全球增長最快的主要經濟體之一，1 月至 3 月季度的 GDP 成長率達 7.8%。然而，未來的經濟前景顯得「模糊」。馬洛特拉指出，西南季風的不確定性、聖嬰現象 (El Niño) 以及中東地區 (特別是伊朗) 的衝突，都為成長帶來挑戰。
由於印度約 85% 至 90% 的燃料需求依賴進口，地緣政治引發的能源價格波動是最大的隱憂。
政策公布後，印度基準 Nifty 50 指數表現持平，10 年期國債殖利率則下滑至約 6.77%。在匯率方面，儘管印度盧比在政策公布後交易價格略有回升，但受資本外流與地緣政治導致的美元走強影響，盧比今年仍是亞洲表現最差的貨幣之一。
雖然央行目前選擇觀望，但匯豐銀行 (HSBC) 等研究機構警告，若通膨從 10 月起連續八個月維持在 5% 以上，央行將難以坐視不管。許多經濟學家預測，隨著 8 月底 GDP 數據的公布，若通膨壓力持續，印度央行可能會在 10 月或 12 月開啟升息循環。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) announced on Wednesday that it would keep its benchmark interest rate at 5.25%, marking the fifth consecutive time the central bank has left rates unchanged. Despite India's retail inflation rate exceeding the 4% medium-term target, the Monetary Policy Committee, led by Governor Sanjay Malhotra, unanimously voted to maintain the repo rate and retain a neutral policy stance.

Data showed that India's consumer price index (CPI) reached an 18-month high of 4.38% in June, driven by rising oil prices. Although overall inflation exceeded the target, Malhotra emphasized that core inflation (excluding food and energy) remained moderate at 3.7% and that there were no signs of broad-based price pressures.
The central bank expects overall inflation to peak in the third quarter before easing and has slightly lowered its full-year inflation forecast to 5.0% from 5.1%.

India remains one of the fastest-growing major economies, with a GDP growth rate of 7.8% in the January-March quarter. However, the economic outlook is 'uncertain'. Malhotra cited the uncertainty of the southwest monsoon, the El Niño phenomenon, and conflicts in the Middle East (particularly in Iran) as challenges to growth.
As India relies on imports for 85-90% of its fuel needs, geopolitical tensions that lead to energy price volatility are a major concern.

Following the policy announcement, the Nifty 50 index was little changed, while the 10-year government bond yield fell to around 6.77%. The Indian rupee, which had initially risen after the policy announcement, remains one of the worst-performing currencies in Asia this year due to capital outflows and a strong US dollar driven by geopolitical tensions.

Although the central bank has chosen to wait and watch for now, research institutions such as HSBC have warned that if inflation remains above 5% from October for eight consecutive months, the RBI will find it difficult to remain inactive. Many economists predict that if inflationary pressures persist, the RBI may start a rate hike cycle in October or December, following the release of GDP data at the end of August.

items.title: 公開押寶下月升息？美財長：深信日本央行總裁植田和男將「做出最佳決策」
items.title_en: US Treasury Secretary Expresses Confidence in BOJ's Decision-Making Ahead of Potential Rate Hike
paras: 美國財長貝森特周二 (4 日) 接受《NHK》專訪時表示，他認識日本央行總裁植田和男逾 15 年，深信植田會採取對日本經濟最有利的經濟決定。他並直言，日本通膨升溫部分源自弱勢日元與能源漲價，待能源回穩、日元過度疲軟獲矯正，通膨可望放緩，使日本經濟與日元進入「良性循環」。此番表態被市場解讀為華府公開押注日本央行 (BOJ) 在 9 月 17-18 日會議上升息。
貝森特長期呼籲日本升息，此次更把匯率干預與貨幣政策掛鉤。他強調，美日上週五 (7 月 31 日) 罕見聯手買入日元，為 1998 年來首度聯合買日元、2011 年後再度協調干預，意在防止弱勢日元引爆亞洲貨幣競貶、動盪蔓延。
貝森特說，「干預釋放信號，但真正改變走勢的是政策」，並稱美方透過紐約聯準銀行賣歐元買日元，此舉兼具「象徵日美合作信任」之意，也避免日本國債失錨連動推高美國長債殖利率。
他還表示，8 月底 G20 財金首長會議將與植田會面，並示警稱日本國債作為全球利率基準的角色不能動搖，美日對「日債安全健全」認知一致。
分析師指出，美國親自下場不全然為日本著想，更憂心日元套利交易反轉與日債拋售潮蔓延至美債市場。短期匯率紅線已由聯合干預劃出，但利差問題未解，BOJ 下月是否升息仍看日本薪資與核心通膨數據。
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen expressed her confidence in Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda's ability to make the best decisions for Japan's economy in an interview with NHK on Tuesday. Yellen, who has known Ueda for over 15 years, stated that she believes Ueda will adopt the most beneficial economic policies for Japan. She also noted that Japan's inflation is partly driven by a weak yen and rising energy prices, and that once energy prices stabilize and the yen's excessive weakness is corrected, inflation is expected to ease, leading Japan's economy and currency into a 'virtuous cycle'. This statement has been interpreted by the market as a sign that the US is openly betting on the BOJ to raise interest rates at its meeting on September 17-18.

Yellen has long been advocating for Japan to raise interest rates, and this time she linked currency intervention to monetary policy. She emphasized that the US and Japan's rare joint purchase of yen last Friday (July 31) was the first time they had done so since 1998, and the second time they had coordinated intervention since 2011, aiming to prevent a weak yen from triggering an Asian currency depreciation and spreading turmoil.

Yellen stated that 'intervention sends a signal, but it's policy that truly changes the trend', and noted that the US sold euros to buy yen through the New York Federal Reserve, which not only symbolized the trust between the US and Japan but also prevented Japan's bond yields from rising and affecting US long-term interest rates.

She also mentioned that she will meet with Ueda at the G20 finance ministers' meeting at the end of August and warned that Japan's role as a global interest rate benchmark cannot be shaken, with the US and Japan sharing the same understanding of the importance of 'Japan's bond safety and soundness'.

Analysts pointed out that the US's personal involvement is not entirely for Japan's benefit, but rather due to concerns about the potential reversal of yen arbitrage trades and the spread of Japanese bond sell-offs to the US bond market. While the short-term exchange rate red line has been drawn by the joint intervention, the issue of interest rate differentials remains unresolved, and whether the BOJ will raise interest rates next month still depends on Japan's wage and core inflation data.

items.title: 賣歐元買日元 美國財長：不惜一切代價支持日本
items.title_en: Sell Euros, Buy Yen: U.S. Treasury Secretary Says He Will Support Japan at Any Cost
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特周二（4 日）表示，在有利於美國經濟的前提下，川普政府將「不惜一切代價」支持日本穩定匯市。
他在接受《CNBC》節目採訪時稱：「我們將竭盡全力支持日本，前提是對美國經濟和美國納稅人有益。」
貝森特在節目中說，美國已加入日本提振日元的聯合干預行動，原因是日元持續疲軟可能破壞整個亞洲市場穩定，甚至引發其他貨幣競爭性貶值，「這種情況很不健康」。
他強調：「考慮到貿易流量、經濟規模以及日本對全球儲蓄市場的貢獻，保持日元穩定至關重要。日本政府明白這一點，我國很榮幸與日本合作，共同落實相關政策，協助地區穩定。」
《CNBC》指出，此次美日聯合干預是美國支持另一主要貨幣的罕見舉措，凸顯出華府對日元長期疲軟可能加劇日本通膨、打壓其他亞洲貨幣、擾亂全球市場的擔憂。
作為美日聯合行動的一部分，美國財政部出售了外匯儲備中的歐元，並將所得資金用於買入日元。貝森特說，他已向歐洲官員說明出售歐元僅為儲備資產重新配置。
「在我看來，歐元匯率已更接近均衡水準，」貝森特說，「我不會評論歐元應該在什麼位置交易，但真正的問題在於日元目前被嚴重低估，以及日本政府正在採取哪些應對措施。」
不過，貝森特也強調，購入日元只能在短期內抑制市場波動，日本仍需通過根本性政策調整應對日元走弱的深層因素。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen said on Tuesday (the 4th) that, provided it benefits the U.S. economy, the Trump administration will "support Japan at any cost" to stabilize the foreign‑exchange market.
In an interview with CNBC, she said, "We will do everything we can to support Japan, as long as it is beneficial to the U.S. economy and American taxpayers."

Yellen explained that the United States has joined Japan’s coordinated intervention to boost the yen because a persistently weak yen could undermine stability across Asian markets and even trigger competitive devaluations of other currencies, which she called "very unhealthy."

She emphasized, "Given trade flows, economic size, and Japan’s contribution to the global savings market, keeping the yen stable is crucial. The Japanese government understands this, and we are honored to work with Japan to implement the relevant policies and help regional stability."

CNBC noted that this U.S.–Japan joint intervention is a rare instance of Washington backing another major currency, highlighting concerns that a prolonged weak yen could exacerbate Japanese inflation, depress other Asian currencies, and disrupt global markets.

As part of the joint action, the U.S. Treasury sold euros from its foreign‑exchange reserves and used the proceeds to buy yen. Yellen said she has told European officials that the euro sale is simply a reallocation of reserve assets.

"In my view, the euro exchange rate is now closer to a balanced level," Yellen said. "I won’t comment on where the euro should be trading, but the real issue is that the yen is severely undervalued right now, and what measures the Japanese government is taking in response."

However, Yellen also stressed that buying yen can only dampen market volatility in the short term; Japan still needs fundamental policy adjustments to address the deeper drivers of the yen’s weakness.
